{"lines":[{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易書，以揲蓍求卦之法，示人趨吉避㐫之機。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118155306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸先賢在說阐眀，各精其義，莫不謂详且𥁞矣。","logicSentenceId":"7633451105394212915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴老人學道数十年，博覧羣書，","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118171690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539560741620678696"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"依書以𣂾事，廣集占騐，存验以考書，書之屢验者存之，不验者刪之。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118171690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如单用世爻，使人有一㝎之見；刪去卦身、世身、星煞、本命，使人無歧路之疑。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118188074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其谈旬空月","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118204458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539560741620695080"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破、刑冲進神，别有奥理。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118204458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓绝生旺，動散反伏，剖晰眞偽，財官父子，法用分占，𥁞闢诸書之讹，獨出一心之悟，發先賢未發之理，啟後人易曉之门。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118220842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惜未成帙，问","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118237226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539560741620711464"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118237226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子得之，不忍秘為枕中蔵，加以增删，编輯成書，亟命剞劂，求序扵余。","logicSentenceId":"7633451105394229299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余曰：野鶴有覺子而野鶴傳，覺子有野鶴而覺子亦傅矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118253610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是為序。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118269994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539560741620727848"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲康熙庚午秋七月，寧陽维則張文撰。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118286378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未仲秋，改換首卷。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118302762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539560741620744232"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此書首卷自前十三篇起，至二十四篇止，另有一段秘法，单敎世之全不知五行生尅之士，亦不必念卦書，只要學會㸃卦，就知决㫁吉㐫，知功名之成敗，知財物之得失，知疾病之死生，知祸福之趋避。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118319146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此四宗大事，竟不必念卦書，則知决㫁，乃野鶴老人苦心扵世之秘法。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118335530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬两黄金無處求。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118351914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易之理㣲乎？","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118384682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰㣲。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118401066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庖犧氏以一畫開天，始作八卦，通神明之徳，類萬物之精。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118417450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文王、周公繋彖、繋爻、繋象，阐明先天至理，精義入神，惟聖人而後知聖人也，㣲乎易乎！","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118433834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"迨鬼谷之後，諸名賢继起，别為五行生尅、世應向背之理，父子兄弟爻、妻財官鬼爻，各以其事為類，以前民用，而闡聖敎。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118450218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善卜者卜之，不善卜者亦卜之。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118466602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"較先聖人揲蓍求卦之法，更简而便，其為趨吉避凶，更明而顯也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118482986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𨓏余㓜年随先大人䆠遊粤西，遇叅両","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118499370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539560741620777000"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徐先生，卜余兄云：将来继起者，此子立㓛封爵，惜乎不克其終。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118499370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜余身命，謂：三十以前，虚譽亦隆，三十以後，垂簾都市，功名不復问矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118515754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼時先大人𠁅極盛之勢，愚兄弟在䕃庇之下，不足其言，誕而置之矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118532138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嗣後兵燹蜂起，家破從戎，先兄立功封爵，實比萤光，果死非命。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118548522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"迨順治庚寅，予投誠㝎南藩下，時年三十有一。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118564906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壮遊都门，滿擬復職，乃竟歸烏有，旅邸萧索。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118581290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"迴思叅两之言，信不誣矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118597674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因遍覔卜筮諸書，静觀两月，即代人以卜吉㐫，有明顯而易現者，有隠㣲而莫測者。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118614058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"每","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118630442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539560741620793384"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占一卦，黙存其稿，至期探之，騐與不騐，悉以筆記，其不騐者，無𠁅考証。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118630442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偶扵江寕遇同郷李我平，问予生平𠩄看何書，即以大全全書、海底眼、黄金策、補遺、易冒諸書以告之。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118646826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公曰：諸書𢘻有悖謬。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118663210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向有野鶴老人，亦存四十餘年之占騐、考証諸書，删闢其謬。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118679594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先叔蒞任雲南，淂此抄本，生平識趨避之途，皆此書之力，久欲刋傳，因未成帙，尚未舉行，送爾抄阅，自知其妙。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118695978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予拜受領歸，靜中叅悟，豁然有㑹扵心，始知従前之騐與不騐，皆書之淂失也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118712362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"閉户二載，遂将野鶴及予之","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118728746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539560741620809768"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占驗，質證古今卜筮諸書，騐者存之，不騐者删之，内有不合扵理者闢之，另淂其巧，騐者增之，分門别類，輯理成部。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118728746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内有煩門细事及諸占騐暨六壬占騐，未及编次，以俟再續。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118745130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是書講觧甚明，初學者不用投師，卽知占卜。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118761514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知易者愈淂其精，精易者愈淂其奥，不須半載工夫，得野鶴老人四十餘年之積學，從此寕有不騐之卦耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118777898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有心覺世者，自不以余言為狂瞽，是為序。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118794282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"康熈二十九年庚午孟夏朔日，湖南李文輝叙。","logicSentenceId":"7586682460118810666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539560741621530664"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：昔者吾友䆠逰時，以此全圖相送。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882521107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"友曰：余不知五行，焉知㫁卦？","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882537491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：先學㸃卦，㸃出卦象，看是何卦，卽在全圖内尋出此卦，照樣粧排。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882553875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應、五行、六親，不用念卦書，卽不知五行相尅之理，亦能决㫁四宗大事，不管卦中動與不動，即照全圖内單看世爻。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882570259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占防憂慮患者，若得子孫持世，無憂；官鬼持世，憂疑難觧，湏冝加意防之。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882586643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占功名者，若得官鬼持世，卽許成名；子孫持世，且宜待時。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882603027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539560741621547048"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占求財、妻財持世者必得，兄弟持世者難求。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882619411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占疾病者，若得六冲之卦，近病不藥而愈，乆病妙藥難調。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882635795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"友曰：何以謂之子孫持世？","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882652179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：子孫與世字同在一爻者，卽為子孫持世。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882668563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘得官鬼與世字同在一爻者，卽是官鬼持世。","logicSentenceId":"7633451613034086451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘兄弟、妻財持世，皆同此說。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882684947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知何為六冲卦者，乾為天，坎為水，艮為山，震為雷，𢁉為風，離為火，坤為地，兌為澤，此八宫頭一卦皆是六冲卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882701331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再者天雷无妄、雷天大壮，亦是六冲卦，一共","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882717715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539560741621563432"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十卦，其餘不是。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882717715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或問曰：求官者，若得官鬼持世，求名必成。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882734099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求財者，若得妻財持世，求財必得。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882750483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘若官鬼爻與妻財爻，或值旬空、月破，或被卦中子孫發動以傷官、兄弟發動以傷財，雖遇官鬼持世、妻財持世，有何益也？","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882766867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：爾知五行之理，神早知之。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882783251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所淂之卦，若非凶中蔵吉，㝎是𠮷裡蔵㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882799635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃神聖引人以知其奧，自然要看旬空月破、生尅冲刑。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882816019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今吾友不知五行之理，神亦早知。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882832403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如若求名，禱扵神曰：功名若成，賜我官鬼持世；倘若失","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882848787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539560741621579816"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"望，賜我子孫持世。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882848787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如占防憂慮患，禱扵神曰：目下若有禍者，卦得官鬼持世，若能免禍逃災者，賜我子孫持世。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882865171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所得之卦，自然顯而易見。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882881555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若又隠㣲者，即是神亦欺人，何以為神？","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882897939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况予作此一般简易之法，單欲敎其全不知五行之士，學會占卦，即照全啚装排，就知决㫁四宗大事。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882914323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘若稍知五行之理者，不可以此為法，務必细看此書後卷，何為空而不空，破而不破，何為墓而不墓，绝而不绝，何為真反吟，假伏吟，何為進不進、退不退，何為囬頭尅者生，何謂囬頭尅者？","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882930707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882947091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539560741621596200"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"䖏可用神煞，何䖏不看用神，何為占此而應彼，何為占逺而應近？","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882947091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何為得其法者，百占百靈；何謂不得其法者，屢占不驗。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882963475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何謂原神有力不生用神，何為忌神無力，能害用神？","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882979859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何䖏闢諸書之謬，何䖏増巧驗之奇？","logicSentenceId":"7586682574882996243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"细觀種種秘法，方能决事如神。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883012627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或又問曰：假令占防災慮患，若得子孫持世，自是無憂；若得官鬼持世，驚恐必見。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883029011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘卦中並不現者，何以决之？","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883045395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：一卦不現，再占一卦；再占不現，明日又占。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883061779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昔人泥其不敢再凟，所以無法。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883078163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予見易徑有云：三人","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883094547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539560741621612584"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占，聼二人之言。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883094547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古人一事卽可决扵三𠁅，今人何妨再凟。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883110931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予生平以来，稍得其奥者，全頼多占之力也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883127315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事之緩者，遲日再占，事之急者，歇歇又占，不拘早晚，不必焚香，深更半夜亦可占之。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883143699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只要單為此事而占，不可又占他事。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883160083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但有心懷両三事而占卦者，非一念之誠，决無靈驗。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883176467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令占功名，或是官鬼持世，或是子孫持世，得其一者，得失已知，不必占矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883192851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不可厭其子孫持世，務必求其官鬼持世而後已。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883209235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此非理也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883225619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如占求財，或是妻財持世，或是兄弟持世，淂其一者則止，不","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883242003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539560741621628968"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必再占。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883242003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘一事而與衆人同其禍福者，各占一卦，决之更易。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883258387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽如行舟遇暴風，家中防火燭，人人俱可占之，但有一卦，若得子孫持世，皆同無患。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883274771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如占疾病，病人自占，若不得六冲卦者，一家俱可代占。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883291155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但有一人得六冲之卦，或係近病，或係乆病，吉㐫自然了矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883307539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予又告吾友曰：此法甚善，名為賽錦囊。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883323923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予㓜時止㑹㸃卦，不知装卦，照此全啚装排决㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883340307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"少經離亂，風波顛險，危䖏叨安，頼此之力。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883356691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但予還有秘法，一並敎爾。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883373075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡係自身之禍福者，只冝暗中占之，照此决㫁，不可","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883389459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539560741621645352"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"令人在傍。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883389459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占過之時，𠮷㐫自知，切不可又将此卦而問識者。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883405843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爾若安心問人，神亦早知，所得之卦，㝎有深奥。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883422227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寕可存此卦帖，待事過之後，然后問人。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883438611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前説防災慮患，及占㓛名，占求財，乃係題頭。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883454995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爾今初學占卦，恐爾不知何事當占。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883471379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今予细冩始末，使爾凢遇後事，照此占之。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883487763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占防憂慮患者，或為國計民生，陳言獻策，或為條陳将相，諫諍君非，恐其事之不行，禍先及己。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883504147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539560741621661736"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或為行江漂海，前途慮賊盜風波；或見逺方火起，恐災殃延及其家。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883520531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或聞瘟疫流行，能為我害；或見飛蝗遍野，能害我苗；或孤行無伴，或廟宿旅眠，家防火燭，宅見妖邪；或随營貿易，或踰險越関，𢦙己入是非之塲，心憂禍患；𢦙欲関閑事，","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883536915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"恐惹災非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㦯入病家，以防沾疾；㦯誤服毒物，恐致傷生；或服人𦲞藥餌，益扵我否；或馭野獣烈馬，恐致驚傷；或己㝎重罪而盻赦，或已得重病，以防危","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883536915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539560741621678120"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883536915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或見逺𠁅有可疑之舟，或見外来有可疑之人，或買官房公地，有後患否？","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883553299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或買山塲塋地，有是非否？","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883569683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或錯買盗物，或立險𠁅，或見隣家有獸頭照壁冲射我宅，能為害否？","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883586067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或見鄰山新葬，及開窑盖廟，犯先塋否？","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883602451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上皆係防災慮患，但得子孫持世者，安如𭰣山，當行即行，有吉無㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883618835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得官鬼持世，憂疑不觧，加意防之，即使當行，亦勿行也。","logicSentenceId":"7633451613034102835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟陳言諫諍者，又非此論。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883635219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若果真正為國計民生，","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883651603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539560741621694504"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"捐軀為國，卽使官鬼持世，亦冝行之。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883651603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前說諸事，以子孫持世而為𠮷，官鬼持世以為憂。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883667987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此二者卦若不現，儘可再占，但有一現者，不必占矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883684371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然又有事之緩急不同。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883700755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令江海開舟，倘得官鬼持世，豈有永不開行之理？","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883717139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈不聞早開一日以逢㐫，遲去半時而免禍。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883733523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘若今日占得官鬼持世，且莫開舟，明日再占，後日又占，但遇子孫持世，卽便開行。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883749907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事之相似者，悉照此可也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883766291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占㓛名","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883782675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539560741621710888"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不拘文武，或已仕未仕，但得官鬼持世，盻陞即陞，候𨕖即選，入塲必中，童試必取，𦊱誤者，官職猶存，㸃名者，前程可復。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883782675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"林下久居，㝎蒙起用。","logicSentenceId":"7633451613034119219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"考職考藝，必取其名。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883799059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"納粟者，名登仕籍。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883815443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"開墾者，加等即陞。","logicSentenceId":"7633451613034135603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問缺者，此缺必得，建㓛者必建竒。","logicSentenceId":"7586682574883831827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㓛，但不冝子孫持世，一切㓛名，盡乃目前失望，待有機會，下次再占。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575129673782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余又以占卜秘法告扵友曰：防災慮患及占㓛名，只","logicSentenceId":"7586682575129690166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539560741621727272"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可自己决疑，不可代人占卜。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575129690166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自占防患者，獨萠一㸃防患之心。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575129706550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占功名者，獨有一㸃㓛名之念，自有靈驗，恐其他人不知子孫與官鬼之理，旣有慮禍之心，又有求名之念，便難决㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7633451613034151987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"譬如上書諫言，此人若無官者，未必不欲借此以求名，而防禍之心亦𠩄不免。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575129722934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有官爵者，旣防㓛名之有失，又慮言出而禍随。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575129739318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如身有前程者，或已仕或未仕，目今𦊱誤，事尚未結，旣慮失官，又防有罪。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575129755702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此三等之人，皆謂之心懷二念。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575129772086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中倘得子孫持世，爾欲許之無事，又恐神報失名；爾若","logicSentenceId":"7586682575129788470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539560741621743656"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"許之，碍扵㓛名，又恐神報無憂。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575129788470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以教爾自占必驗，代占不靈，非卦不靈，他心不專于一也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575129804854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如在任占地方之驚變及旱澇荒災，此即謂之防災慮患。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575129821238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得子孫持世，盜息民安。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575129837622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得官鬼持世，諸災必見。","logicSentenceId":"7633451613034168371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但不可占逺年，只可占本歳，雖占本歳，亦不可将此数事一卦而占，須冝每事另占一卦可也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575129854006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如己見驚變，惟恐𦊱誤，此即謂之慮㓛名之有失。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575129870390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539560741621760040"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最喜官鬼持世，不冝子孫持世也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575129886774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如在任無事之時，禱於神曰：我蒞此任，将来能扵陞否？","logicSentenceId":"7586682575129903158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得官鬼持世，一定髙遷，子孫持世，必有𦊱誤。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575129919542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如未逹之士，或才品優長，或武藝過人，占我终能成名否？","logicSentenceId":"7586682575129935926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼持世，食祿有期，子孫持世，終無可望。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575129952310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如或有祖䕃，或己援例，或己立㓛，凡係己有部劄、批文、委牌等事，問我将来終能出仕否？","logicSentenceId":"7586682575129968694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼持世，一㝎飛騰。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575129985078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫持世，安心株守。","logicSentenceId":"7633451613034184755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如士子先占一卦，","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130001462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"今科中否，若得官鬼持世。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金㮄","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130001462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539560741621776424"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"標名，倘得子孫持世，卽知今科而失望也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130001462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"改日再占，下科中否？","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130017846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘又得子孫持世，又知下科不能。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130034230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"另擇一日，再占，終身可能中否？","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130050614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得官鬼持世，終能奮發。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130066998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘得子孫持世，改業他圖，可免儒巾之累。","logicSentenceId":"7633451613034201139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孝廉占會試，童生占入學，皆同此法。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130083382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上此法，皆秘法也，湏要切切問去，卦無不靈。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130099766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘若未問目下，先問終身久逺之事，殊不知神報近事者多。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130116150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世人不識此理，胸中多少未决之事，先問终身，神且報爾胷中之疑。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130132534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而㫁卦之人，亦不知此","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130148918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236262813748"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神意，竟以終身㫁之，天壤之隔，全無影响。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130148918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占財，問錢両可能徴𠬧𠯁否？","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130165302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"領錢糧可能全領否？","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130181686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻財持世豊𠯁，兄弟持世貱賠。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130198070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問買賣徑營，開張店面，及逺𠁅求財，或見貴求財，倘得妻財持世，速冝行之。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130214454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟持世，湏冝止之。","logicSentenceId":"7633451613034217523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占經商貿易，開張店靣，若已行乆矣，問将来興廢何如，皆得妻財持世，愈乆愈豊。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130230838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘得兄弟持世，従今衰矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130247222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236262830132"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占囮貨者，妻財持世，此貨可𠬧。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130263606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟持世，切不可買。","logicSentenceId":"7633451613034233907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占放債者，兄弟持世，有借無還。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130279990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻財持世，始終両好。","logicSentenceId":"7633451613034250291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占取債，妻財持世，即使目下不得，終湏有還。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130296374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄第持世，改日再占。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130312758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘若屢占而淂兄弟持世者，如水中以撈月也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130329142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若屢占而淂官鬼持世者，必要經官。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130345526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占開金銀銅鐵鉛鑛，及開煤窑𥖯山，及買山伐木，園林、塩池魚沼，凡係山崗江海以取利者，若得妻","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130361910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236262846516"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財持世，物阜財豊。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130361910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟持世，破財折本。","logicSentenceId":"7633451613034266675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占燒丹煉，永世無此理。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130378294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦不必占，念亦莫起，卽使卦淂妻財持世，乃應别𠁅之財。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130394678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曽有人占焼，且卦得戌土財爻持世，午火子孫，發動相生，祗謂戌月一㝎成丹。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130411062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"誰知九月妻妾子孫，由數千里而来。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130427446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"異郷圖聚，戌土財者，而應妻妾，午火子孫者而應子女，此乃占此應彼，可見易為君子謀，非理之求，神不報此而應彼也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130443830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占地下，忽見光彩異物，或見黄白奇形，疑其有財","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130460214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236262862900"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130460214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若淂妻財持世，必有金銀；兄弟持世，不獨無財，反有破財之事。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130476598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘若官持世者，必是妖邪。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130492982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"告吾友曰：世人凢有疑難，開口則曰求神問卜，可見欲知未来之𠮷凶，除卜之外，無他矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130509366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予習周易有年，所卜之事，感應之理，就如神聖，開口說話，真令人毛骨悚然。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130525750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因爾不知周易之妙，不念卦書，不淂不送此秘訣，試去行之，爾見其靈，従此自肯念書學卜。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130542134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此法甚善，爾亦可以傳人。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130558518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"缙紳士民，行商㘴賈，無人不可不用，湏要全不知五行生尅之人，方用𬼘法。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130574902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"倘若稍知.","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130591286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236262879284"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行者，神必現隠㣲之卦，湏要看用神生尅制化、月破旬空，並看後卷求名、求財及疾病章㫁法，不可以此為法。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130591286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吾友拜領而去。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130607670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一别二十餘年，異日相會，予曰：蒙賜全圖，真如錦囊。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130624054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數十年來，避凶趨𠮷，全得此力。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130640438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"許多细事，難以枚舉，畧以㡬宗而告之。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130656822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽有一日，有𠬧放錢糧之差，應當委我。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130673206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聞他人以財幹辦。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130689590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予占一卦，兄第持世，知有賠累，聼伊幹之。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130705974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後果貱賠不已。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130722358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又因地現銀鑛，衆约予𫔭，予占數卦，不現兄弟妻財持世，難以决㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130738742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屢占，見其兄弟持世，知其無益，决意不","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130755126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236262895668"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130755126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"他人開過年餘，費過數千餘両，後竟掘出泉流。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130771510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予淂免此浪費。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130787894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又一日，舟泊南昌，忽見西北雲起，疑有風暴，同舟之人俱已占過，不見官鬼、子孫持世，亦難决所。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130804278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"末後稍子占得官鬼持世，予卽速命開船，灣扵避風之䖏。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130820662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"少刻，狂風大作，江上壞船二十餘隻，獨予得免。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130837046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又因賤荆偶得瘋疾，危在朝夕，身原虗弱，醫命人𦲞救之。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130853430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又一醫曰：服人𦲞即𢀸。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130869814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予占得震為雷，變雷澤歸妹，乃是六冲卦，𦲞藥俱不用服，知其近病，逢冲即愈。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130886198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果于申日退災。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130902582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"還有両宗大事，身家性命𠩄","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130918966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236262912052"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"関，皆得保全。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130918966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一日，觧餉十萬，行至花山，午月甲子日，占得艮為山，官鬼持世，知其有盗，吩咐梢子傳知同行之舟，且莫開行，他船不聼，俱已開去。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130935350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及至巳時，塘兵報曰：前船被盜，後趕上，見之，哭聲両岸。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130951734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又扵巳月壬申日，與衆鄊人避亂扵山，衆曰：此地不穩，移住靈鷄洞避之。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130968118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予占一卦，問：此地穩否？","logicSentenceId":"7586682575130984502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占得天雷旡妄，午火子孫持世，約衆勿遷。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575131000886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有不信者，竟自遷去。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575131017270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後被賊人放火薰洞，洞内之人俱𮞸烟𢀸，獨予合室保全。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575131033654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此數事，非身家性命之所関也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575131050038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余今願領其敎，欲識五","logicSentenceId":"7586682575131066422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236262928436"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行生尅之理，可得聞歟？","logicSentenceId":"7586682575131066422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：周易之道，知天時之旱澇，識地利之豊歉，知時運之興衰，知疾病之生死，知㓛名之成敗，知財帛之聚㪚，知禍福之趨避為人不可不學易也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575131082806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孔子曰：假我數年，五十以學易，可以無大過矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575131099190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爾今先念渾天甲子六親歌，占出卦来，㑹装五行六親，再學變動，卦中必有動爻，動則必變。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575131115574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣知動變，然後再看用神、元神、忌神。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575131131958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知此者，卽如入周易之門也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575131148342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再看四時旺相章、五行相生相尅章，五行相冲相合章，旬空月破、生旺墓绝章，又如升周易之堂矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575131164726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1242","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236262944820"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再看後卷各門各類，占何事，以何法㫁之，漸漸由淺入深，以得其奧，不湏半載工夫，得予數十年之積學也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575131181110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今予先点一卦，敎爾學看用神及五行生尅旺衰之理。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575131197494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡問事者，先冩年月日辰，再照六神章中冩出六神，然后占卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575131213878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽如占得乹為天卦，","logicSentenceId":"7586682575131230262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1247","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丶世，戌土，父母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丶申金，兄弟，丶午火，官鬼","logicSentenceId":"7586682575131230262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1249","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。丶應，辰土，父母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丶寅木，妻財。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575131230262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丶，子水，子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7633451613034283059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1252","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236262961204"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1253","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236262977588"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1254","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236262993972"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1255","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"增刪卜易","logicSentenceId":"7586682575131246646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1256","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"二","logicSentenceId":"7586682575131246646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1257","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236263010356"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1258","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236263026740"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自占𠮷凶者，以世爻為用神。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575131279414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦世臨戌土，卽以此戌土為自己之身，冝扵旺相，最怕休囚，冝逢巳午之火以相生，最忌寅卯之木而相尅，又不冝世爻落空，更不冝世臨月破。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575131295798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此世爻戌𡈽，有四𠁅生尅冲合，月建能生尅冲合，一也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575196782634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦世爻戌土，若在寅卯之月占卦，被寅卯之木傷尅，卽為世爻受傷。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575196799018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自占𠮷凶者，謂之休囚不利。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575196815402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在辰月占卦，辰冲戌土，戌為月破，此謂之世爻","logicSentenceId":"7586682575196831786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1265","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236263043124"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢月破。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575196831786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽如子己身子如破物也，百無𠩄用。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575196848170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在巳、午月占卦，巳午之火，乃是官星，能生戌𡈽，謂之火旺𡈽相。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575196864554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻逢旺相，諸事可為。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575196880938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在未丑月占卦，此両月𡈽旺之時，亦能幇扶戌𡈽，此世爻戌𡈽亦謂之旺相，亦以為𠮷。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575196897322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在戌月占卦，世爻戌𡈽而為月建，此乃旺相以當時也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575196913706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自占𠮷凶，諸事亨通。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575196930090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在申、酉、亥、子月占卦，此戌土為洩氣之時，謂之世爻休囚無力。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575196946474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1274","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236263059508"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此謂之月建能生尅冲合戌𡈽之用神也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575196962858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知何以謂之用神者，自占𠮷凶，用此世爻為主。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575196979242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不曰世爻，而曰用爻。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575196995626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占父母，以父母爻為用神，日辰能生尅冲合，二也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197012010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦世爻戌土，若在寅、卯日占卦，寅卯之木，能尅戌𡈽，此世爻受日辰尅傷，不利之象。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197028394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在辰日占卦，辰冲戌𡈽，謂之世爻暗動。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197044778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在巳、午日占卦，巳午之火卽是官星，能生戌𡈽，此謂之世爻逢官星而生旺，諸事𣅜𠮷。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197061162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1282","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236263075892"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在未、丑二日占卦，𡈽遇𡈽而幇扶，此戌𡈽亦為得助。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197077546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在戌日占卦，謂之世爻臨日建，當令得權。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197093930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在申、酉、亥、子日占卦，此戌𡈽無尅無生，此謂之日建能生尅冲合用神也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197110314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中之動爻，能生尅冲合，三也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197126698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦世爻戌𡈽，倘卦中苐二爻寅木發動，能尅戌𡈽；第四爻午火官星發動，能生戌𡈽；第三爻辰𡈽發動，能冲戌𡈽，此謂之卦中之動爻，能生尅冲合","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197143082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1288","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236263092276"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197143082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻自動，變出之爻，能囬頭生尅四也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197159466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻發動，動而必變，變出巳午之火，謂之回頭生世；變出寅卯之木，謂之囬頭尅世.變出辰𡈽，謂之囬頭冲世。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197175850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變出卯木，謂之囬頭合世，此謂之用神自動，變出之爻，能生尅冲合用神也。","logicSentenceId":"7633451613034299443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上四處，若得全来生合用神者，諸占全𠮷。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197192234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘有三䖏相生，一䖏相尅，亦以𠮷㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197208618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有両䖏尅，両䖏生者，湏看衰旺，生用神之神旺相者，則以𠮷㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197225002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅用神之","logicSentenceId":"7633451613034315827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236263108660"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神旺相者，可作凶推。","logicSentenceId":"7633451613034315827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘遇三處相尅，一䖏相生，若得相生之爻旺相者，亦可謂之尅䖏逢生，凶中得解。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197241386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若值休囚者，有生之名，無生之實，與四䖏俱来尅者同㫁，諸占大凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197257770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或問曰：此卦世爻戌𡈽，並無變出寅卯巳午之理？","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197274154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：他爻多有變出囬頭生尅，借此以為法也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197290538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又問曰：卯木能尅戌𡈽，又與戌合，還以為之尅，還是以之為合？","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197306922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：五行相合章註解極明。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197323306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又問曰：此卦乾為天，卦中午火作官星是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197339690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如何","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197356074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1307","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236263125044"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午月午日占卦，亦以此午火作官星，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197356074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：不拘占得何卦，卦内若以巳午火作官星者，如遇巳午月日占卦，此巳午月日亦作官星。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197372458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中若以巳午之火作財星者，而日月巳午亦作財星。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197388842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣𬼘。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197405226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相休囚者，四時旺相，章查之，空破者，旬空月破，章查之。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197421610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲合者，五行相冲，五行相合，章查之，生尅者，五行相生，五行相尅，章查之。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197437994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元神者，元神，章查之，用神官星者，在用神，章查之。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197454378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1315","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236263141428"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"暗動者，在暗動，章查之，囬頭生、囬頭尅者，在動變生尅，章查之。","logicSentenceId":"7633451613034332211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰月建者，在日辰月将，章查之。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197470762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占父母者，以卦中之父母爻為用神。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197487146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦辰、戌両爻俱是父母，若両爻俱動或俱不動，擇其旺者而為用神。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197503530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如一爻動者，擇其動者為用神。","logicSentenceId":"7633451613034348595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母旣臨辰、戌二𡈽，卽以𡈽為父母，冝火相生，怕木相尅，忌臨月破、旬空。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197519914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦有四䖏生尅冲合，但冝生多尅少為𠮷。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197536298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與前世爻叅看。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197552682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1324","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236263157812"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占宅舎舟車、文書章奏，皆以父母爻為用神，湏在用神章细看。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197569066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占他人者，以應爻為用神。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197585450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦應臨辰𡈽，欲其𠮷者，冝四䖏相生，欲其衰者，冝四䖏以冲尅。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197601834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占兄弟者，以兄弟爻為用神。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197618218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦申金兄弟卽用此爻，宜𡈽相生，怕火相尅，忌臨月破、旬空。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197634602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦有四𠁅生尅，俱是多生少尅為𠮷，尅多生少為凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197650986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：兄弟爻乃刦財之神，如占弟兄姐妹之否泰者，冝其生旺，不冝臨月破、旬空。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197667370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如占妻妾婢僕及","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197683754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561236263174196"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財物者，最冝多尅少生，更喜逢空逢破，使其不能刦我之財，尅我妻妾婢僕。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197683754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占妻妾婢僕及占財物者，以妻財爻為用神。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197700138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦寅木妻財卽是用神，忌臨旬空月破，冝水相生，怕金相尅，亦有四處生尅，多生少尅為𠮷，與前同看。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197716522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占金銀買賣，皆以妻財為用神，湏在用神章中细看。","logicSentenceId":"7586682575197732906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸書無不以青龍為吉，白虎為凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383556650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元賦曰：身旺龍持多喜慶。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383573034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"碎金賦曰：龍動家有喜，虎動家有喪。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383589418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383605802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"筮元龜曰：螣蛇、白虎憂尊長。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383605802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜筮大全曰：畏𠼫刀之白乕，喜戲水之青龍。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383622186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"阐奥章：占疾病，螣蛇主𢀸，白乕主丧。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383638570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此皆不以五行，竟以六神而斷生死。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383654954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368527935"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟千金賦曰：𧆞興而遇𠮷神，不害其𠮷；龍動而逢凶曜，難掩其凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383671338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此正理也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383687722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然則六神而不騐耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383704106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非也，乃附和之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383720490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦之吉者，逢青龍而更𠮷；卦之凶者，逢虎蛇而更凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383736874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且元武主盗賊，朱雀主是非，無不騐也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383753258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於家宅墳塋，不可少也。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383769642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子日占生產，淂山地剥變風地觀。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383786026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368544319"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子水子孫化絶變鬼，𠥽日落草而亡，却是青就臨子孫，亦可謂之喜耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383802410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如申月甲辰日占兄病，得屯之震。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383818794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子水兄爻為用神。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383835178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中忌神、元神同動，土動生申，申金動而生子水，月建又生子水，至戊申日沉疴𣸪起，豈可謂之“蛇動主死，虎動主丧”耶？","logicSentenceId":"7630458295338516480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368560703"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如辰月己巳日占會試，淂觀之否。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383851562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青龍加未土，文章持世，動化囬頭之生，日建五爻作官星，共来生世，必然鼎甲傳臚，果中鼎甲。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383867946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如未月戊辰日占官事罪之軽重，","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383884330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539555103368577087"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世臨卯木，旣墓于未月，又遇酉金鬼動，冲尅世爻，加临白虎，谓之白虎𠼫刀，予曰：罪之凶极。","logicSentenceId":"7586699082383884330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼问：凶在何時？","logicSentenceId":"7630458295338532864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：酉金化午火，目下無碍。","logicSentenceId":"7630458295338549248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋後防之，果至重刑。","logicSentenceId":"7630458295338565632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jnhmy/1-7630135606245212175_QQ_1776530187143.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=6vJTAHgHHA%2Bxdq1Nc6A5T2B5cAw%3D","pictureHeight":452,"pictureWidth":210,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jnhmy/1-7630135606245212175_QQ_1776530187143.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=i9%2FUhAmV1BHDJIT9vM01WBCu8hs%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1jnhmy/1-7630135606245212175_QQ_1776530187143.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
