{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子旬中戌亥空，甲戌旬中申酉空，甲申旬中午未空，甲午旬中辰巳空，甲辰旬中寅卯空，甲寅旬中子丑空。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136164879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何謂旬空？","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136181263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子至癸酉日為一旬，此十日之内，并無戍亥，","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136197647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t8zbcj/1-1757658006312.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=ZLKQJ78Oy7a1UPuJtm3k8McW%2FRM%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/3/ref/1le3cy4t8zbcj/1-1757658006312.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":"7549083341049724968"},"logicSentenceId":"7586683329136197647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以爻逢戌亥為旬空，又名空亡。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136197647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136214031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旬空之法，諸書之論太繁，有真空、假空、動空、冲空、填空、援空，無故自空，有故而空、墓絶空、害空、安空、破空。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136230415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313476935732"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：旺不為空，動不為空。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136246799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有日建動爻生扶者，不為空，動而化空，伏而旺相，皆不為空。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136263183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月破為空，有炁不動亦為空，伏而被尅亦為空，眞空為空。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136279567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"真空者，春土、夏金，秋是木，三冬逢火是真空。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136295951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余初學卜，凡遇旬空，無法而斷，欲以之為到底全空，𨚫又應乎填實之日而不空；以之為不空，却又到底全空。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136312335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後淂多占之法，凡遇旬空，命之再占，卦𠮷者許之出旬而不空，卦淂凶者，許之空矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136328719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313476952116"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰月乙卯日，占求財得家人之贲。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136345103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世，卯","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136361487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136361487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥丑，丑卯兄","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136361487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子水。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136361487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父母父財兄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見丑財持世，遇旬空，雖有巳火之生，巳火又化囬頭之尅，不能生丑土之財。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136377871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此財旣無生扶，當主難求。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136394255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又因三月之丑𡈽財還有氣，古法有炁不為空，不敢竟𣂢。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136410639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命之再占，世應，淂暌之損巳","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136427023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未酉金丑，子孫卯巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父㐲，","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136427023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子永財。戍𡈽，兄鬼父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313476968500"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因浔此卦，合前卦而决之，竟𣂢曰：財無氣矣，不必勞心。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136427023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼問：何故？","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136443407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：前卦丑財雖則空而有氣，後卦子水財空，伏扵五爻未上之下，伏而又空，空而被尅，知其無財而無超也，果浚全無。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136459791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如子月辛亥日應世，占逺行求財，得大畜。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136476175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅木子水，戌土辰土，寅木子水官財、兄，兄官財，世逢寅木，子月亥日，俱作財神而生世，又喜應爻。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136492559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為地頭，世應相生，乃全美之卦，獨因世值旬空，若","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136508943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313476984884"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"執古法𣂢者，無故自空，大凶之兆，敢許之而逺去耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136508943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命之再占，又淂明𢑱世應之豊，酉亥","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136525327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑土鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥丑卯父兄","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136525327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"，午火兄，財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼子，𣂢曰：此卦與前卦相同，此行大有所淂。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136525327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻丑𡈽化午火，回頭相生，目下月破，甭到地頭，巳出月矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136541711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出月而不為破，𫔭春寅卯月，以前卦决者，乃世爻出空之月也，逢子亥財生，美心如願。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136558095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：去淂成","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136574479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313477001268"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"否？","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136574479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：甲寅日，世爻出空之後，惟行無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136590863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵乙卯日起程。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136607247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後到彼地，寅卯月间，諸事遂心，滿載。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136623631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而歸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：多占之法，損許多疑惑。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136640015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不然，止以前卦决，𣂢者，無故自空，如入深淵大壑。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136656399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺財生世，腰纒萬貫之徵，許之去耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136672783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"阻之勿去耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136689167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如寅月辛卯日，世應占父何日回，淂觀卯、己","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136705551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未土父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯巳未之否。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136705551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財鬼午火，財鬼父，此卦父遇真空，日月傷尅，雖則動不為空，疑其傷","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136721935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313477017652"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之太重，予不敢𣂢，问之：去了㡬時？","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136721935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：父𫔭店扵某𠁅，離此三百多里，常去常来。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136738319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昨有信回，這两日要到，不知起身否？","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136754703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予命之再占。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136771087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應得離變中孚。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136787471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌申金","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136803855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"，午火父。丑卯巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄、子孫、未土兄鬼父，此卦又是父動逢空，幸淂日月生父，較前卦不同。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136803855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又喜父動尅世，尅世者速至，許甲午乙未日必到，果扵未日返舍。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136820239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：此卦日月生父，許之必来是","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136836623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313477034036"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136836623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前卦真空，何以無凶？","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136853007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神無二理，此卦若是，前卦為非。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836924071988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：前卦何甞不是。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136869391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未父持世，目下旬空，出空而見父也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136885775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"决課之人，要識来人之念。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136902159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伊父逺渉天涯，存亡未審，必存𠮷凶之念而问，若遇真空，必不歸也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136918543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今乃徃米熟，道𠩄問者何日而囬，凑至未。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136934927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日必到。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136951311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猶伊问曰：我父何日歸家？","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136967695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猶神告曰：甭父未日卽至。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329136984079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我初淂見，我亦動疑，故命之再占。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329137000463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若再得凶卦，卽以云新。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329137016847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣淂𠮷卦，合而决之，𠫵悟神之意矣。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836924088372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曽扵午月己丑日占隂晴，得臨之師卦，初","logicSentenceId":"7586683329137033231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313477050420"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初爻己大父動，當應己日必雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329137033231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及至癸巳日，早滿天紅日，值伙友在座，亦知易理，命之卜今日雨否？","logicSentenceId":"7586683329137049615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午月癸巳曰：淂應世旣濟，變澤火革子戍","logicSentenceId":"7586683329137065999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申金，父亥母卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄鬼亥，水兄鬼子。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329137065999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余曰：今日申時有雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329137082383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伙曰：申父雖動，日月尅之，况巳與申合，合住父爻，不雨，雨從何来？","logicSentenceId":"7586683329137098767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：不然，定有大雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329137115151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵申酉時雷雨交作。","logicSentenceId":"7586683329137131535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次日，伙曰：不以月傷日合而𣂢大雨，何其神乎？","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209251368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：非獨昨日之卦","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209267752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561313477066804"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209267752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑日占過，原應巳日必雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209284136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猶我而問神曰：前卦應今日之雨，今果雨否？","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209300520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猶神而曰：今日申時有雨，不在乎尅與合也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209316904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前卦而𣂢行人鳥，猶彼曰：我父何日而歸？","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209333288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦猶神曰未日必到，不在乎空而真也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209349672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡卜易卦，必與鬼神合其機，勿膠柱而鼓瑟。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209366056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余淂多占之法，雖不能合鬼神之機，能叅悟鬼神之機也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209382440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690868180746294/1-f96deb0c0bb58886.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Xv2Q3wFaOKxUm2s9xKV4i%2BlfFBE%3D","uri":"read/HY1496/7/ref/1kp70c4dmf7yr/1-f96deb0c0bb58886.webp","fontType":1,"components":"𦘒皿","variants":"盡","charPicId":"7456690868180746294"},"logicSentenceId":"7586683330209415208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼神之機也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209415208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之理，皆従空而生，謂之懸空而待。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209431592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占遇空，不可卽以為空，須視其𠩄占之事，或近或逺，如在旬内，則為空也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209447976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然亦有冲空之曰，實空之時，事在一旬之外，許其出空之曰而應之。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209464360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若占逺大之事，尚無㝎期，非出旬可以成者，大象不𠮷，乃可謂到底空也。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209480744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大象若𠮷，太歲月建六可填之，然又不如多占两卦，實妙法。","logicSentenceId":"7586683330209497128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動静隂陽及覆遷變。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836925268020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前卷動變章註解極明。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946496006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太過者，損之斯成。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946512390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：主事爻重疂太多，事不專一，故冝損之。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946528774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946545158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423393718291"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土為主事爻，爻中多逢辰戍丑未，謂之太過，湏待寅卯月日尅制玉爻，然後成事。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946545158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或占時淂遇寅卯月日者𡖋好。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946561542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：不獨後逢寅卯月，曰後逢辰月辰日者，二許成事。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946577926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946594310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰乃土之墓庫，謂之用爻重疂，須墓庫以收藏是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946610694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣𬼘。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946627078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不及者，益之則利。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946643462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何謂不及？","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946659846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若主事爻止有一位，又不旺相，謂之不及，其事難成。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946676230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423393734675"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如金為主事爻，若在夏天占淂，卽為休囚无炁，若淂日辰、動爻生之，或待後来逢生助之月日，皆有利益，其事亦成。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946692614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余以此論是理，但要主事爻原有根蒂，衰而逢生者，如旱苖之得雨也，勃然而興，故謂之有助有扶，衰弱休囚六吉。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946708998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只恐衰弱無根，休囚失陥，雖逢生合，亦難生也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946725382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈不闻制中弱主，難以维持，生扶拱合，時雨滋苗，尅害刑冲，秋霜殺草。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946741766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前五行生尅三合六合章，月将日辰章、三刑六害","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946758150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423393751059"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"章，註解極明。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946758150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長生帝旺，争如金谷之園；死墓绝空，乃是泥犁之地。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946774534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前生旺墓绝章、空亡章詳之。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946790918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰為六爻之主宰，月将乃萬卜之提綱，前日辰月将章詳之。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946807302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最惡者，歳君冝静而不冝動。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946823686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲君乃當年之太歳是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946840070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或明動晴動，冲尅世爻，占年運者，一年撓括。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946856454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占官事者，必干朝廷。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946872838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"士子占試，任䆠占官，及面聖上書，叩阍諌諍請封。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946889222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423393767443"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"請䕃等事，皆冝太歳生合、世爻，動而生世更吉，最忌刑冲尅也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946905606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"除此數占之外，皆與他爻等也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946921990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946938374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太歳雖司一年之令，尊而不親，髙而難仰，吉凶皆不及乎日月。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946954758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以太歳不理家庭细事，此理是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946971142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以太嵗冲爻而為歳破，不以為凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251946987526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合爻為崴合，不以為𠮷。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836925284404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻之衰者，太歲不能生之；爻之強旺者，太嵗不能制之。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251947003910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇日跛者卽破，逢旬空者卽空，非化月建、日建之力也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251947020294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：作當年之禍福，不以為重；作浚時之吉凶，","logicSentenceId":"7586689251947036678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423393783827"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其實不輕。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251947036678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且","logicSentenceId":"7633450836925300788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如主事爻屬木，爻中申酉金動，謂之木被金傷，縦使木旺金衰，目下可保無事。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836925300788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後遇申酉之歲，難免其𩧫。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251947053062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如己月壬子日，占應世鄉試，淂水地比子戍申卯己未財，兄、子官、父兄巳火父爻。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251947069446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當月建，文星旺矣，獨嫌官星持世，卯木旬空，許之卯科，方能得意。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836925317172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子年占，果于卯年登科。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251947085830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應卯年者，太歳填實而不空也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251947102214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423393800211"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不騐者身位，冝刪而不冝存。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251947118598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊係","logicSentenceId":"7633450836925333556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最要者身位，喜扶而不喜傷。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836925333556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"原註：有云：古用世身而不騐，故用卦身。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251947151366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：卦身六不騐，止用世爻。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251947167750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：间有睔者。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251947184134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：比之用世爻，百發而百中也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251947200518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"间有之䎾，乃偶然凑合耳，何足為法。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251947216902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世為己，應為人，大冝契合。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251947233286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世為自己，應马他人。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251947249670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占彼此之事，燕而用之，欲他扶助我者，喜應爻生合世爻，我欲代他而謀事","logicSentenceId":"7586689251947266054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423393816595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，冝世爻而生應也，非占彼此而不用也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251947266054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如卯月辛巳日應世。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251947282438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占自陳何如。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836925349940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淂戌申","logicSentenceId":"7633450836925366324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午酉子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥母恒之升，財官","logicSentenceId":"7633450836925366324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑官財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父財。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836925366324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余曰：酉金持世，破而且空，又動出午火相尅，不獨於職，須防，五六月還見凶炎。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251947298822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：幸淂世應相生。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251947315206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又變升卦，必有救解。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251947331590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余曰：自占自陳，與應何干？","logicSentenceId":"7586689251947347974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此迂腐之論也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689251947364358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果于五月下徾。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268265779241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動馬，始變為终，最怕交争。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836925382708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423393832979"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動爻為事之始，變爻為事之终，冝生合，不冝冲尅。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268265795625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應位𮞸傷，不利他人之事，世父受制，豈冝自己之謀。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268265812009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自占者，冝世爻旺相，或臨日月，或日月動爻扶助，或動而化𠮷，諸占皆𠮷。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268265828393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占他人以應爻為用，喜他旺者，冝臨旺相之地，又宜曰：月動爻以生扶，喜他衰者，冝臨墓绝空破之郷，及日月動爻而冲尅。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268265844777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應俱空，人無准實。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268265861161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世空，自己不真。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268265877545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應空，他人不實。","logicSentenceId":"7633450836925399092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應俱空，彼此皆","logicSentenceId":"7586689268265893929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423393849363"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無准實。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268265893929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謀事有阻，事屬荒唐。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268265910313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内外競發，事必翻騰。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268265926697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中動爻少者，𠮷凶自有條理，容昜剖㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268265943081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若内卦外卦纷纷亂動，則吉凶靡芝，必人情不常，事軆反覆，全無㝎論之象。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268265959465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"湏爯占一卦，合而决之。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268265975849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世或交重，两目肩瞊扵馬首。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268265992233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應如發動，一心似扥扵猿攀。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908141568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：世應皆不冝動，動則及復不常，如馬首而不㝎，似猿意而無寕。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266008617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423393865747"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：予不敢以之為是，六不敢以之為非。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266025001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃用神不旺，大象不成之說也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266041385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若用爻淂地，大象當成。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266057769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世動不受尅制，應動生合世爻，圖事，成之更速。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266074153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爻有炁無他，故，所作皆成。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266090537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主象徒存更被傷。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908157952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡謀不遂，用爻及主象，即主事之爻也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266106921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或旺相，或有生扶，㦯有氣，並無他爻尅制，事之必成。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266123305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘哀弱無力，又逢尅制，雖則出現，六，無用矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266139689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻遇旬空，空逢冲而有用。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266156073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得遇日辰冲者，謂之冲，","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266172457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423393882131"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空則實，不惟不空，反為有用。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266172457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘動而空者，日辰冲之而更實，合𮞸跛而無功。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266188841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：爻逢相合，如两人同心，事不克濟。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266205225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若日月動爻冲尅者，又為合䖏逢冲，頎防小人挑唆，合好之中，以生疑忌。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266221609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如占自為之事者，尔被傍人挑阻，我事難成。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266237993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予得騐者，凡三合六合，雖不冝目下日月動爻冲尅，又宜浚来之月日冲闬，正厮謂。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266254377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢合住，冲破成功。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908174336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如爻中寅與多合，若在申巳月日","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266270761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423393898515"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占者，申冲寅，巳冲亥，名為合𠁅逢冲。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266270761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若非申巳月日，占者，在待浚時，逢申巳之月日，方成其事。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266287145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266303529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以不動六為之合，非也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266319913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"两爻皆動，始為合也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266336297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動空化空，皆成㓙𠮷。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266352681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊係必成凶咎。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908190720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余淂騐者，動不為空，動而化空，六不為空，吉凶皆應扵冲空實空之日，予故改之。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266369065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑合尅合，終見乖滛。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266385449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：合者，和合也，見之為吉。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266401833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不知合中有刑有尅，畢竟不合。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266418217","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用午字為财爻，未字為福神，囙午","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266434601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423393914899"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"字而帶自刑，名為刑合，不以為合而為刑也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266434601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：午旣自刑，乃自有刑害之禍，淂福神而作合，是救解其禍矣，反為不𠮷者，非也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266450985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余嘗渴騐，世爻午火化未相合，已定重刑，浚竟得蒙赦免，動逢合而徉住。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266467369","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：忌神動逢曰月相合，則不成凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266483753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元神動逢曰月合住，則不濟事。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908207104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此忌有理。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266500137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但予得騐者，浚逢冲開之月日，吉凶俱","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266516521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423393931283"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266516521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如未月庚寅日，世應占官運淂𦍬，變未酉","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266532905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亥兄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後母卯既濟，官父，申兄官子。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266532905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：世臨及水，今歲子年，太歳拱扶九五，酉金雖不發動，六舎生世之意，世爻又化回頭之生，又淂日辰相合，上爻未土，官星當權，淂令，仕途平坦，如水以行舟也。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908223488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟疑權操兩省，不為不冨。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266549289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如何兄爻持世，財伏被尅，𬼘美中之不足也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266565673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公问：浚日何如。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266582057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423393947667"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：防巳年太歲冲亥刑申，不無缯蹬。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266598441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"榮歸之曰：只落淂四海一空囊耳。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908239872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果于己年被論，窅索消索。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266614825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃世逢合而徉住，逢冲之年月則開矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266631209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"静淂冲而晴興晴動，章中註解明白。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266647593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入墓難尅。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266663977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：墓者，滯也，忌神入墓，不尅用神。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908256256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如木為用神，金為忌神，善在丑日，占者，金入墓矣，焉能尅木？","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266680361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423393964051"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中動岀丑支，六同此。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266696745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推金爻動而化丑，六是，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266713129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：是則是也，屢見浚逢冲開墓庫之日，依然木彼金傷，帶旺匪空。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266729513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺者乃旺相之爻，而遇旬空，不作空論。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266745897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘遇本日之日辰冲者，謂之空逢，冲而有用，遇後日之日辰冲者，謂之冲起，過此一旬而出空者，謂之填實，俱不為之空也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266762281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘若發動，更不為空，","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266778665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423393980435"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有助有扶，衰弱休囚亦𠮷。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266778665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此指主事爻而言。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266795049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如主事爻無氣，本為不美，若淂曰痕與動爻生扶拱合，卽為淂助，與前不及者，益之，則利相同。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266811433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪生貪合，刑冲尅害皆忘。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266827817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此六指主象而言。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266844201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如主象臨卯木，遇申爻動而尅之，卦中若動出及水，申金貪水之生，不来尅木。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266860585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如主事乆臨子水，遇卯木動而相刑，若淂傍支動出戍字，卯與戍合，不来刑子，此乃貪合忘刑。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266876969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423393996819"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如世臨巳爻，卦中動出寅字，本是寅来刑巳，却淂寅木生巳火，謂之貪生忘刑。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266893353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如用爻臨巳字，卦中動出煖水，冲尅巳火，若淂卯未同動，交卯未合成木局，反来生火六，謂之貪合，忘尅忘冲。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266909737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘皆倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266926121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逐頦推詳，别衰旺以明尅合，辨動静以㝎刑冲。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266942505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰旺尅合，前五行生尅及四時旺相章中已註明白。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266958889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動静刑中者，前動變章業已註明。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266975273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"併不併，冲不冲，因多字眼。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268266991657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑非刑，合非合，為少支神。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908272640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394013203"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：卦爻旣成，未免有刑、冲併合，然多一字不成其名，少一字六，不成其刑、冲併、合之名也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267008041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如子日占卦，卦中有一子字，則謂之併，若有二子字，則分開而太過也，名雖為併，其實不能併之。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267024425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二午則不冲，二母則不合，二卯則不刑，二巳則不尅，此多一字不成刑合、尅害之名也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267040809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：若是爻中一子不合二丑，名為妬合，不成合者，六有理也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267057193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"差以日辰不能併爻中之二子，不能冲爻中之二午者，非也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267073577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月如天，無𠁅不沾兩","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267089961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394029587"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"露，不然，何以謂之廵察六爻之善惡？","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267089961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽如丑月壬子曰，世應占訟，得遯卦戊申午申午辰父兄鬼兄鬼父，㫁曰：世臨午火，子日冲之，休囚為日破，不為晴動，今日若審，必有責罰，果不本曰見官責杖二十。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267106345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卽卦見二午，豈可謂之一子不冲二午耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267122729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：寅、巳、申為三刑，若有寅、巳二字而無申字，㦯有寅申两字而無巳字，但少一字，不成三刑。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267139113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394045971"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：交卯未為三合，卦有其二，内少一字者，不成三合。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267155497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：此二者皆非其說，須不知虚一待用、待浚時之月日，可以填之。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267171881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如己月己未日","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267188265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"占應世。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乆病，得困之元契。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267188265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未酉交午辰","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908289024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。寅財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄子鬼父巳，㫁曰：世文寅木，化出巳火，寅能刑巳，三刑少申字，妨申日之危。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908289024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果卒于申日申時。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267204649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃少一字，得浚","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267221033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394062355"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"来申日補之，豈可謂之少一字不成三刑耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267221033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如酉月乙巳日應世占陞遷，淂澤之萃、","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267237417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未父。酉。亥卯巳未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變天地否卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267237417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊兄子財、官父巳火官星持世，又臨曰建。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267253801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜書曰：官臨日月卽陞。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267270185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且己日冲動亥爻，與發動之未爻，欲成三合，因少卯字，明年卯月必陞。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267286569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𬼘乃虗一待用，果陞卯月，豈可謂之少一字不成合也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267302953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻遇令星，物難我害。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267319337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394078739"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰月将章註解極明。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267335721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏居空地，事與心違。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267352105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏，㐲神也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267368489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏而又空，諸事難成之象。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267384873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊存占驗。","logicSentenceId":"7586689268267401257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙應世申日占文書，酉交丑辰，","logicSentenceId":"7586689279300993043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅木。子官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子財。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279300993043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄兄㐲","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908305408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳人父母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財，以父母爻為用神。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908305408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦六爻無父，毋巳火父母伏扵二爻寅木之下，又遇旬空，所以文書而不成也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301009427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：伏而又空，事之不成者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301025811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但此卦文書","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301042195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394095123"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之不成者，非因空也，乃因飛爻在寅，㐲神在巳，與申日作三刑之故耳。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301042195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301058579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申日冲動寅木，以生巳火，謂之飛未生伏淂長生，伏神既淂長生，則為有炁不空。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301074963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不然，何以謂之飛不仲，𫔭忐枉然。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301091347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予故曰：非因空也，三刑也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301107731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏無提挈终徒伸，飛不搉闻点枉能。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301124115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡用神不現，伏扵卦中，須冝月建日辰，冲𫔭飛神，生合，扶起伏神，而伏神卽為有用。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301140499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如占文書，應世","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301156883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394111507"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淂貢卦，寅子戊亥丑卯，官財兄財，","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301156883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"休午火鬼父母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以父母為用神，午火父母伏扵丑土兄弟爻下，可言有人把住文書。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301156883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在未月日占者，冲去丑土飛神，合起午火伏神，而為文書有用。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301173267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在寅卯月日占者，尅去丑土，生起午火，点仆乆書有用。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301189651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301206035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空下伏神，易扵引拔。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301222419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏神不空，而飛神空者，伏神易扵出現。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301238803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301255187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飛神既空，乃上無壓住之爻也，而伏神再淂月建日辰","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301271571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394127891"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生扶拱合，脱然而出矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301271571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"制中弱主，難以堆持。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301287955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爻休囚，又被月建日辰制伏，縦遇生扶，点不濟事。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301304339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰月丙辰日占世，乂丶應，地下忽然起五色，巳未","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301320723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酉金丑土，子孫兄第。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301320723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳火父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之光，疑有古窖。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301337107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父伙","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908321792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子水財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊酉鬼，","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908321792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑土兄牙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余曰：財伏而空，全無影响。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908321792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伊曰：既是無財，何故有五色之光？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301353491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：乃妖氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301369875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼時人人望財，議論纷","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301386259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394144275"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"纷。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301386259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有曰：子動爻中，兄弟交重，偏有望。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301402643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦兄動生子，子動生財，又是内卦合成金局，金生水旺，何曰無財？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301419027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余曰：爾知其一，不知其二。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301435411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫雖旺，難生無蔕之財。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301451795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子水伏而又空，又被日月飛神尅制，財從何米？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301468179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浚竟掘之，挖淂破缸一口，盡皆厇屑泥土。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301484563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日傷父，真罹其禍。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301500947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻傷曰，徒受其名。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908338176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月如天如君，六爻如臣民萬物，日辰能刑冲尅害淂卦爻，而卦爻不能刑冲尅害乎？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301517331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月墓中人，不冲不發。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301533715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394160659"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：大抵用爻入墓，則被阻滯，諸事費力難成，湏淂日辰動爻冲破，或尅跛其墓，方有力也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301550099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如戊寅日占財，淂同人之乾卦，用爻入墓，喜淂日辰尅破，浚果淂財。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301566483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以用空入墓，許以無財者，非也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301582867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不知旬空而遇冲，冲空則實；雖墓而尅破，破墓則闻。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301599251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：此極有理，屢試屢騐，但要用神有而方可許之。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301615635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘若用神休囚無援，雖遇冲開之曰，点難發矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301632019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如未月戊辰日占應世","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301648403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394177043"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年運，淂地雷，復變酉亥丑辰寅子。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301648403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謙卦，子財兄","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908354560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼，","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908354560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908354560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：世爻子水，雖是申子辰三合水局，不冝日月尅世。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908370944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻化墓，又化囬頭尅，動爻，辰土又尅，此乃世爻休囚而無無也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301664787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯年占，卒于午年。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301681171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應午年者，世臨嵗破之年也，豈可謂之墓中人？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301697555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不冲而不發，非身上鬼不去不安。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908387328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸占最怕尅世，獨官鬼持世者，若非職役之人，最","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301713939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394193427"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜日月動爻来相冲尅，及為吉矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301713939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301730323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非尅世爻，乃尅去身遑之鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301746707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如午月癸母日應世。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301763091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占妻病，淂萃之未酉","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301779475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亥水，子孫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301779475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/2/ref/1lbojz50hgi0i/1-1756285367961.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=IXhKEfPQrmvlAG2CMOZZXcBrjwo%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/2/ref/1lbojz50hgi0i/1-1756285367961.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":"7543187163887304744"},"logicSentenceId":"7586689279301779475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未，叱父兄","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301779475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申金兄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301779475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"弟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301779475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301795859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"问：来人病淂幾時？","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908403712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：自三月病起。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301812243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：卯木財空，明日出空，必然退炎。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301959699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：醫家不下藥矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301976083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279301992467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦交水，子孫獨發，尅去世爻之鬼，應在明日。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302008851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅曰：寅與亥合，合起子孫，之曰：甭無憂也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302025235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302041619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394209811"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次日退災，不藥而愈。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302041619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"点不獨此，又因卯木財空，次日出空而退災。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302058003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曾如辰月戊子日，占應世，小舟過闕，防盤阻，淂子戊申","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302074387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卯鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己未，水地比變，澤山咸。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302074387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財兄子申，父兄世下之鬼，乃滿腹憂疑之象，疂畳申金，尅去身遑之鬼，則無憂也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302090771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵卯曰過𨴢，並無阻滯。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302107155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徳入卦，無謀不遂。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302123539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：徳者，徳也，與天地合其德，主事爻與世爻，天","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302139923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394226195"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干地支上下相合是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302139923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"存有占騐。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302156307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊月己酉日，占文應世書，淂小畜變蠱卦。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908420096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302172691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳火，子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302172691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰寅","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302172691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子水。父母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄丙子，財，财兄辛丑。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302172691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂五爻動出丙子，文書與世爻變出辛丑，干支相合，應戊子日，成其文書。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908436480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余以此論為多事之諭也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302189075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：鬼谷三才論舎交辭，以五行而𠯁禍福者，乃用地支。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302205459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣用地支，不淂不以天干為配，未闻以天干而㝎吉㓙。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302221843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以天干配地支者，欲全用周天甲","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302238227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394242579"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子卦，又止扵四十八爻，不淂不分晰焉。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302238227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以乹之内卦用甲，坤之内卦用乙，乃十干之首。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302254611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾之外卦用壬，坤之外卦用癸，皆十干之尾。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302270995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾之内卦用子，與坤之外卦相合；坤之内卦用未，與乾之外卦相合。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302287379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二老上下相媾，隂陽磨盪，中包六子。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302303763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙之次者，丙丁用之扵少男少女，艮與兌也；戊己用之扵中男中女，坎與經也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302320147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛用之扵長男長女，零與。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908452864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"異也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302336531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以全上下干支，此乃配偶之法也，故謂之渾天。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302352915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908469248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而禍福吉凶，皆地支生尅制化尅合刑冲","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302369299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394258963"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以判之。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302369299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今又以天干而判休咎者，每卦皆冝用也，何獨扵此？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302385683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况此小畜變蠱，五爻朱雀為文書，動臨巳火，變出子水文書，而世爻又臨子水，父母又為文書，酉日生之，化丑，合之，叠叠文書旺動于卦中，便非干支相合，難説無成。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302402067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余故曰多事之論也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302418451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌臨身而多阻無成。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302434835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌卽忌神，諸占不冝持世。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302451219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如占官，子孫卽為忌神，子孫持世，求名不成。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302467603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占財，兄爻為忌神，兄爻持世，求財不𮒗。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302483987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394275347"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：此論極是，然予亦有騐者。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302500371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄爻持世，化出財爻而淂財，世臨財爻，化出父母而見父。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302516755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如己月丙申日，應乂世，占財，淂未濟變己未酉","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302533139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午，兄火弟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰寅。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302533139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易卦兄子財、酉金子父，此乃尼臨世位，化出酉財，卽于酉日淂財。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908485632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如申月戊午曰，應世，占領文，淂風雷益卯巳未","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302549523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰之財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅子卦，兄于財。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302549523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亥水。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908502016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"，父毋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父，","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908502016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394291731"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此亦忌臨世位，卽于酉日而淂文書。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908502016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同日子占父，六，淂此卦，交日見父，其故何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302565907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"疑是動爻不尅變爻之故耳。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302582291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然点無多見者，予既淂騐，不淂不以告之，非敎人為法也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302598675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸占必以忌神持世，多阻無成者為是。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279302615059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如午月己酉日，應世，占求財，淂未濟之巳未酉午辰","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393267755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。寅木父母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"暌兄子財、兄子巳火，凡占求財，最忌兄爻持世，此卦忌臨世位，當主無","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393267755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394308115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393267755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幸寅木父毋動而生世父毋爻者，非金銀也，乃貨物也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393284139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
