{"lines":[{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求金銀而不淂，貨物必淂，果于寅日淂盃盤。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393300523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"汝假應寅日者，父爻出空之曰也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393316907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦遇凶星，避之則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393333291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：凡值用神空三遇曰月勅爻冲尅者，謂之避。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393349675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空及不遭其冲尅之害，舊存有占騐。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393366059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未月壬申日，占子應世，病，淂姤之大過。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908518400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊土父母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申午酉亥丑未土兄鬼兄子。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393382443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908534784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394324499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂父母旺動，用爻亥水，子孫無氣，本為凶兆，喜得用爻值旬空而避之，至丙子日而愈。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908534784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖丙子者，則前面巳過，又是亥水子孫值子日，以臨帝旺之故耳。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393398827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：此論非理。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393415211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸占最惡者，忌神旣動于卦中，禍已萌矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393431595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神静者，逢冲之日𮞸𠵊。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393447979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神動者，逢值合之曰𮞸傷。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908551168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神破者，實破之曰而遇。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908567552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用空者，出空之曰相逢。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908583936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是乃未曽出空，可以避之，出空必遇其害，豈曰出空則前面巳過，反不受其禍耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393464363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"悖","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393480747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394340883"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也，謬也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393480747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予淂其騐者，元神動扵卦中，用神空者，出空之日淂福。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393497131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌神動于卦中，而用神空者，出空之日逢殃。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908600320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屢占屢騐。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393513515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨近病逢空不論。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393529899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占近病，用神淂遇旬空者，不拘曰月動爻尅害用神，云空之曰卽愈。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393546283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨此一事論空，不論尅也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393562667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"他占皆忌。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393579051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此姤之大過，定是占子近病，不悟近病逢空卽愈，而曰諸事皆可避之，此誤後人也，宜刪之。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393595435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父逢忌殺，敵之無傷。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393611819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註忌爻發動，凡事不利，差得曰：月動爻幇肋，用","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393628203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394357267"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻，可以敵之，不弱扵彼，事点可成。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393628203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余以此論是理，但伊所存之占騐無理。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393644587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申月乙未日，占脫","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393660971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應世","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"役，淂損之莭。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393660971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅子鬼財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌母卯巳子成元兄鬼父，謂世臨丑土，而子水财動，生助寅木之鬼，動而尅世。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393677355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜淂曰：辰未土，五爻上又變出成土，扶助世爻，可以敵其寅本之鬼，不能傷身。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393693739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：以此仆後人之法者，六誤人也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393710123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393726507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一重","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393742891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394373651"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未土扶世，豈可敵其助鬼傷身之惡殺那？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393742891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不知。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393759275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅木鬼動，月建破之，未日墓之，𬼘寅水之鬼破而又入墓矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393775659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子水雖生，不生無根之木，况子水又化囬頭之尅，水木皆枯，浚保無事者，此也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393792043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"誤仆戍未二土幇扶者，錯也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393808427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况變爻戊土，従無幇助正卦之爻，余有一例，可以比之。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393824811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰月乙未日，占月應世○令，淂泰之豊。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393841195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉友、","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908616704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑兄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，辰","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908616704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子、子財、午兄丑財，","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908616704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394390035"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻辰土，月建𦔳之，丑土動而化回頭之生，又米化助。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908616704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖則寅朩鬼動，而世爻旺相，有助有扶，可以相敵。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393857579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然此浚至卒丑日，尚点見其㐫，非因一言觸怒上官，㡬乎叅𠁅，幸解救而息。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393873963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫應解救者，因淂日月之土幇扶也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393890347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主象休囚，指見刑冲尅害。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393906731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主象旺相，尚難敵乎刑冲尅害义爻，况休囚耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393923115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前篇有云：尅害刑冲，秋霜殺草者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393939499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用又變動，忌𮞸𢀸墓绝空。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393955883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394406419"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：死墓绝空，乃陥阱之地。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393972267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若用爻動而化墓化绝、化死化空者，不问公私大小之事，皆主不成。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279393988651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占病逢必死無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394005035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余淂𱻻者，化墓、化绝，若動爻旺相，或臨日月，或日月幇扶，六無大害。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394021419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化墓者，冲𫔭之月日而成。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394037803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化绝者，逢生旺之月日而就。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908633088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至扵化空之說，更淂多騐。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394054187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占謀事，實空之日必成；占近病，出空之日卽愈。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394070571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用化用，有用無用。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394086955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：旣有用爻，不可動而又化，云来，謂之化去，㦯","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394103339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394422803"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傍爻出，皆不濟事，故雖有用，昂如無用爻一般，占病尤忌。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394103339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：此論非理。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394119723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爻化出，用爻善化進神，諸占皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394136107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽使他爻動出者，更淂此助幇扶，何謂無用？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394152491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈不知太過者，損之斯成。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394168875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：用爻重疂，淂墓庫而収蔵。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394185259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如果用神太過，待至傷損之日，墓庫之日。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394201643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成之更穩，反曰無用，非也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394218027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此亦當則空化空，雖空不空，余淂騐者，不獨空化空則不為空，動卽不為空矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394234411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394439187"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為禍為福，冲空實空之月日，必應。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394250795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飬主孤疑，墓多暗昧，此亦長生沐浴十二位之星是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394267179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余用生旺墓绝，其餘不騐。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394283563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今之化出者亦騐。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394299947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺墓絶，墓者，滯也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394316331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神動而化墓者，近病久病，遇之主昏迷之象。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394332715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神旺者，中開墓庫之日則安。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394349099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神休囚，又被刑冲尅害者，難愈。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394365483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢空者，近病愈，久病凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394381867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"埔檴遇之，深逃難覔，身命遇之，愚蒙不振，失脱遇之，暗蔵不見，婚姻遇之，皆暗昧不明之象。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394398251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394455571"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如若動爻化墓，而墓神囬頭尅動爻，勿以暗昧昏滯而論，乃凶兆也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394414635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌囬頭之尅我者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394431019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如差墓神為鬼，回頭尅用更㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394447403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化養、化病、化胎及化沐，治俱不騐，盡巳删之。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394463787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化生旺𠔃，禍福有三。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394480171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生者，動爻化長生也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394496555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如交水動，化出申金，旣化長生，又曰化囬頭之生。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394512939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化酉金者，不曰化沐洽，而曰化回頭之生。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394529323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此二生者，動爻有氣，化爻旺相，諸占皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394545707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394471955"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺者，長生之第五位者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394562091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金木水火而化旺，卽是化進神。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394578475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如申金化酉金，交水化子水，寅木化卯木，巳火化午火，諸占無不亨吉。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394594859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟土寄生扵申，旺扵子，不為進神。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394611243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仪戍、未土動而化出子爻者，乃為化旺。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394627627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑土化少子爻者，旣為化旺，又為化合，諸占皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394644011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化官鬼号，吉㓙有二。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394660395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動爻變出官鬼，吉㐫有二。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394676779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394693163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占㓛名者，世爻旺相，或臨日月，或日月生扶，動而變出官星，又無破","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394709547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394488339"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"損，乃為淂官之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394709547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世若休囚受尅，動而俊出官星者，乃為變鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394725931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不惟難扵王家食祿，湏憂夢枕黄梁。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394742315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如戍月甲寅，曰：占應⺀世候遷，何時淂缺？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394758699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394775083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卯兄巳未辰財寅于父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖變蹇卦，子子財","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394775083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申鬼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄辰，世臨月破，寅日傷尅，又上爻動出，卯木尅之，有尅無生，世爻變出官星，乃為變鬼，卒扵次年寅月，竟未淂缺。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394775083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而佟猶神告曰：命限當危，㓛名不必望矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394791467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如己月壬申日，世應","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394807851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394504723"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占開店貿易，淂坤","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394807851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394807851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑卯巳未之剥卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394807851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財兄鬼父兄，㫁曰：占生意，看財爻。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394824235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦財臨月破，雖則子動生財，生之不起。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394840619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况世與子孫一同變鬼，不獨營運，勿圖，今秋必因子女以致官非。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394857003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵八月，因子賭博送官，子受杖刑而死。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394873387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此應酉金子孫變鬼，忌囬頭之尅。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279394889771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我爻動而化尅者，如金爻動，變火尅金，木爻發動，變出金而尅木，謂之囬頭尅也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279728812073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279728828457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394521107"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：予存占騐，凡見囬頭之尅，占病、占夀、占年運者，淂之十有九𢀸。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279728844841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦有占名利，或占家庭佃務而淂之者，六見危亡。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279728861225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其故何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279728877609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其人大限至矣，自己無知，猶有名利之求。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279728893993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如神告曰：數之将盡，何用他求？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279728910377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"儆戒勿貪，庶不蹈乎網羅。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279728926761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽使難扵迴避之，可保其正寢。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279728943145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"疑神之告，乃此意耳。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279728959529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟官鬼持世，化子孫回頭之尅，騐之有四。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279728975913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"現任官貟占淂者，有應傷子，有應削職，有應夭詩。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279728992297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"士庶𫥐之者，有應自身損壽，有應傷子。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729008681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394537491"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凢淂此卦，必湏命之再占，合而决之，方可一言。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729025065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而㝎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟占防患者，相冝化出子孫，尅去身邊之鬼，而無憂也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729041449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占六親，最忌化回頭之尅。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729057833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽如占父母，父臨巳午火，若化辵子水，囬頭尅父，乃父母不壽之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729074217","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729090601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世如酉月己丑日，占師子，戊土申金辰寅子專官事，淂屯之震卦兄。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729106985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官父，申午，火鬼子兄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"断曰：申金父母為用神，巳入墓矣，又化囬頭之尅，","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729123369","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394553875"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目下巳㝎重罪。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729123369","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：可能减等？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729139753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：不獨减䒭，此公必不𮞸刑。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729156137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今歲辰年歳五相生而不尅，况淂父爻，又遇青龍，决非刑憲。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729172521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因午火旬空，防午年去空，必淂善終。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729188905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又出命帖看之，壬辰戊申、戊寅甲寅。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729205289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：𬼘乃食祿制殺格，今年交丙運，乃梟神奪食之運，幸七月堅金，丙運焉能鎔化？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729221673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"湏防內年丙月，烈火前金，正合前卦，午火實空之年也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729238057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浚闻巳㝎大辟，蒙改缓决。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729254441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至丙午年丙月丙日，淂肺疾，疾厥而終。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729270825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃代占六親，忌囬頭之尅，又是命卦合成，","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729287209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一理。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394570259"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勿及徳以扶人。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729287209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古法相生湏冝他生我，相尅還冝我尅他。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729303593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如占彼此両家之事者，冝應爻而生世。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729319977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如占財者，冝财生世，如占官者，冝官生世。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729336361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若世去生肋，他爻，洩盡自己之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729352745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惡曜孤寒，怕日辰之併起，刑冲尅害之爻，卽為惡曜，非諸星之凶煞也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729369129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凢見此爻動而冲尅用神，若𬼘星孤立無助，或休囚無力，雖則傷害用神，而用神旺相，可以敵之，必然無","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729385513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394586643"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"碍，淂禍亦輕。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729385513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟怕日辰動爻，助他為虐，彼必狐假康威，仗勢作惡，淂禍之不淺也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729401897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前月将日辰章内，最怕他爻増尅制，同𬼘意丹。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729418281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爻重疊，喜墓庫以收蔵。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729434665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：用爻重疂，若無日辰動爻損之，必湏淂墓庫収藏，然沒可得。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729451049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊存。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729467433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占騐。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729483817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑日占財，應世，得益之萃","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729500201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。卯兄巳未財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰寅","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729500201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未子交財兄未","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729500201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394603027"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729500201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：卦有两財，初交上爻，又化出两財，日辰又是財，本為太過，喜淂世上有辰字，乃為財庫，謂之財有庫以𠬧蔵。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908649472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浚主淂財。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729532969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余以𬼘論，極其淂理，屢試屢騐，但不必卦中有庫。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729549353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無庫，常見浚来逢庫之月日，点成其事。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729565737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如午月戊午日，世應，占何日雨，淂地酉亥","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729582121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑土酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729582121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母風升變恒卦，鬼父","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729582121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午火，子孫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼父財。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729582121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"友人執此卦问予曰：今日占雨，父毋不動，而丑土","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729598505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394619411"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之財又化出午火，回頭之生，竟是大旱之年也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729598505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：壬戌日必雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729614889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"友曰：父臨月建，隂雨連旬。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729631273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今子孫臨月建，𡖋同此意，如何淂雨？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729647657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：午火子孫臨日月，旺之極矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729664041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃為用爻重疂，逢墓庫而𠬧蔵，故知戍日必雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729680425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵戍日申時雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729696809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丑月丙申日應。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729713193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○世占淂水火旣濟，子","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729729577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊，土鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申交水，","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729729577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑土鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯變泰卦，兄亥父兄寅木子，此乃冨家之子，年僅十七，占终身功名。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729729577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予淂此卦，","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729745961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539557423394635795"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知其壽夭，又不便言点，不以卭名許之，只曰：功名尚早，重重鬼動尅世，連年還有病災，過二十歲，脱此鬼厄。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729745961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再問㓛名，火刻，此子業師而问曰：旣问終身功名，何故多鬼尅世？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729762345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：神報夀夭，故不以功名而告也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729778729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：防扵何時？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729795113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：今年太歲在丑，難過十九辰年。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729811497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：辰年冲去戊鬼，如何不村？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729827881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余曰：非此論也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729844265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰乃土鬼之墓，鬼太旺，必湏墓庫𠬧蔵，果𢀸扵辰年戍月。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729860649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事阻隔，号間發","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729877033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481285664809"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729877033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：世應中间两爻，謂之间爻，動則事多阻隔。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908665856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂此两爻在世應之中，動阻兩家之事，使彼此不能相通。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729893417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：世應中間两间爻發動，所求多阻隔。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729909801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：以此两爻作為间爻，試之果騐。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729926185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但看所占何事，湏是彼此两家之事，始可用之。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729942569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婚姻以之為媒妁，詞訟以之為中記，買賣以之為牙行，借貸成交以之為中保，舟車以之為附載，交逰樂之為幇间，胎產以之為𠬧生保母。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729958953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481285681193"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世為己，應為人，彼此欲相親者，若遇间爻發動，不可槩以阻隔㫁之。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729975337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若動而生合世應，反淂此軰之力。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279729991721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"近世爻者，幇我之人也；近應爻者，幇他之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730008105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生我者，我冝親之；尅我者，我冝逺之，獨忌尅乎世應，事必難成。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730024489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅世者，壞我之事，我被其愚；尅應者，懷他之事，他被其愚。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730040873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若淂兄動，其害叡小；破阻其事，耗财而已。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730057257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若淂鬼動，必受其累。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730073641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如己月庚辰日，占應世買宅，淂臨之大壮，酉亥","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730090025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑土，丑土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730090025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄弟兄第巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481285697577"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰土，子財午火，兄鬼父，断曰：世爻卯木，應爻亥水，乃是世應相生，必成之象。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730090025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但嫌亥臨月破，不能生世。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730106409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况間爻三重丑土發動，乃成羣之小人，従中被阻，事已壞矣，難許成交。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730122793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：樣銀業已付訖。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730139177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因彼用人與說合之人，多索徧費，未滿其愁，故伊悔言不賣。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730155561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：目下便多許之，六無成也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730171945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應爻破而被尅，難得二家成就。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730188329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浚果不成，退囬様銀。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730204713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此公大怒，煩當道親友徃彼理曰：前日因何𫠦見，引我醮看内室，今又因何所見，退","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730221097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481285713961"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"還㨾銀。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730221097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸親徃彼，𥁞叱其非，彼点甘受。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730237481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予詳卦中之间文，三重土動近應爻者，卽如賣主身遑之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730253865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅應爻者，破阻賣宅不成而無財也。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908682240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"近世爻之土点尅應爻者，卽是買主央去之親友，衆叱其非。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730270249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡遇间爻動者，得曰月中尅，可解。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730286633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心退悔𠔃世空。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908698624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：自占世為主象，若無曰月動爻傷尅，而世爻無故自空者，必主心惰意懶，自不向前。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730303017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：此論為是。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730319401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前曰無故勿空，如入深滅大壑，","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730335785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481285730345"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸占大凶者，非也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730335785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易林補遺有曰：世應者空，两下","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730352169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"目","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前退悔，主賔皆動，二邊日浚更張，所以不獨世空，應爻点不冝也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730352169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故謂之世應皆空，事無惟實。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730368553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凢動而空者，不以此論。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730384937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦爻發動，湏看交重。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730401321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：交動主未釆之事，重動主過去之事。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730417705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余点多試，间有騐者。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279730434089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡爻象有一㝎而不可移者，可以為法。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279753977919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"间有騐者，乃偶利之凑合，不可執之。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279753994303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481285746729"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動變比和，當明進退。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754010687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"近退章己註明白。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754027071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赦生身莫将吉㫁，用尅世，勿仆凶看。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754043455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖生中有刑害之両防，合𠁅有尅傷之一慮。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754059839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺生世者，是日月動爻作忌神而生世也，非凶煞也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754076223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不以吉斷者，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754092607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂忌神既旺，用神衰矣，世雖逢生何益？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754108991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"青","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元虎","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754125375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"蛇勾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱如戌月內子日，占父","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754125375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應世，酉亥，母丑卯巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"任雲南何。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754125375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"時淂信，淂地澤臨卦，子財兄，兄官父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481285763113"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占信者，朱雀巳火，父毋為用神，日辰子水尅巳火，卽為忌神，戊月乃巳火之墓，点為忌神，此巳火月墓曰尅，音信，茫然之兆也。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908715008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而世爻卯木雖遇曰生月合，何益扵事？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754141759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺生身，勿将吉㫁，此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754158143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浚果無音，遲四年，知父而遇害矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754174527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用尅世，勿仆厶看者，乃用神来尅世也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754190911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：生事丈動来尅世，乃是事来趕我，事必易成，我雖見尅，点何傷哉？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754207295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故云尅世者，不以為凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754223679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：此論未為全是，予之淂騐。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754240063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如占求財，財為","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754256447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481285779497"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神，财爻尅世者必淂。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754256447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占行人，用神尅世者卽至。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754272831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占醫藥，子孫為用神，子孫尅世者即愈。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754289215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外此數占，皆不冝用神而尅世也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754305599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若占㓛名，官鬼尅世，非災卽禍，豈可曰勿仆凶看。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754321983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754338367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如占𨴢差淂否，丑月酉金亥水、丑土、辰土、寅木、子水，庚子日淂泰之明彛，子孫、妻財、兄弟、兄弟","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908731392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官鬼，丑土，妻財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占明差，以官鬼為用神。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908731392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦地土持世，寅木官鬼尅世，因世爻空，郎扵壬寅日淂差，次年三月𢀸扵中途，豈可謂之用尅世，勿仆凶看邪？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754354751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481285795881"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如午月丙辰曰，世應乂，占遷居𠮷否，淂謙酉金、亥水、丑土、申金、午火","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754371135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"、辰土，父母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之明𢑱，兄弟子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754371135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父母，兄弟，官鬼，卯財木。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：占宅舎，以父母爻為用神，此卦辰土父母動而尅世，不冝遷之。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754387519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：業已成矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754403903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：目下不碍，秋来不利。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754420287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754436671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：辰土動化卯水，秋采木被金傷，辰土来尅世矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754453055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵七月地震，房屋倒塌，人眷被傷。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754469439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此可謂之用尅世，不以凶耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754485823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑害不冝臨用，","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754502207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481285812265"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主事爻與日月動爻，仆三刑者，占事不成，占物不好，占病必死，占人有患，占婦人不貞潔，占文書有破㝎，占訟必有罪責。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754502207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動而化刑者，点然臨𢀸者，屢試不騐，故不註之。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754518591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𢀸绝豈可持世。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754534975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爻，世爻绝扵日辰，或化绝者，舊註諸事不利，余以休囚被尅而又絶者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908747776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相不妨，動逢冲而事散，三冲六冲章，註解極明。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754551359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481285828649"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"绝逢生而事成。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754567743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凢世與用神，或絶扵日，㦯化绝，若淂月日動爻生者，謂之絶䖏逢生。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754584127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如寅日占卦，酉為用神，酉絶扵寅，若在辰戊丑未月，或爻中動出，辰成丑未，以土生酉金，皆謂之絶䖏逢生。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754600511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣山。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754616895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女逢合住湏冲破，","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754633279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以成功。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇休囚，必旺相而成事。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754633279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應期章内，註解極明。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754649663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"速則動而尅世，缓則静而生身。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754666047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此獨占行人而用之，他占不用，","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754682431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481285845033"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂用神動而尅世，行人回来之速也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754682431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神静而生世，行人歸未缓也。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908764160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如占父母何日囬，父毋動而尅世者，許之卽歸。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754698815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754715199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父亡而事無頭绪，福隠而事不稱情。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754731583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古法曰：卦無父母事無頭，卦無子孫不喜恱。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754747967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余以此論，亦為多事。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754764351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占事者，用神、元神、忌神、仇神、尅害、刑冲、破墓、絶空、日月、飛伏，許多事故，尚無。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754780735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㝎論，還敢尋不當用之爻耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754797119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予恐枝業多生，反無頭绪","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754813503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481285861417"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754813503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼雖禍灾，伏猶無炁。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908780544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元賦中無鬼論，雖則有理，實点多事。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754895423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余生平以来，占官、占鬼、占疾病，當用者則用，不當用者則不用也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754911807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子雖福徳多，及無切覺。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754928191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子曰：以之為忌神者，實則不冝；以之為用神者，多則何害？","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908796928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈不闻損之斯成，逢墓庫以收蔵也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754944575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎興而遇吉神，不𠲘其馬吉；龍動而逢凶曜，難掩其為凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754960959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481285877801"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此謂淂理。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754977343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六神章内巳解明矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279754993727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元武馬盗賊之事，点必官爻。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755010111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀本口舌之神，必圎别弟。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908813312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此論欠理。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908829696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元武、朱雀、勾東、滕蛇，動而不尅世者，無碍，動而尅世，皆以為凶。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755026495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勿分兄弟官鬼，𠮷凶神煞之多端，何如生尅制化之一理。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755042879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此至言也，學者冝深味之。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755059263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"涂惡未盡","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755075647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690872462393407/1-cf261a91b4b211e6.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=xTgrxmQIM6qPQzqX3aNPZ18i%2Bi8%3D","uri":"read/HY0872/12/ref/1kob2uyrwl06e/1-cf261a91b4b211e6.webp","fontType":1,"components":"⺊夕巳","variants":"死","charPicId":"7456690872462393407"},"logicSentenceId":"7586689279755075647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"灰，湏防復焰。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755075647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅害刑冲之神，若淂曰月動爻尅制者，湏盡其根。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755092031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481285894185"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若除而未盡，将来遇生扶之年月，仍復為禍。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755108415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如卯月甲申日，世應占病，得地山謙","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755124799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。亥水酉子孫，丑申、午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰變水山蹇，兄戊土父兄鬼父。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755124799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：亥水子孫長生扵申日，世遇日建之生，雖化戊土之尅，春令土衰，卯月尅制，有救無妨，果扵丁亥日全愈。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908846080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈知卯木雖尅戍土，還有相合之意。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755141183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥水雖遇長生，戍土点淂長生扵申浚，至巳月，亥逢月破己火，生助戍土，諺云：斬草不涂根，萌芽依舊","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755157567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481285910569"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發，仍復番病而死矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755157567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"害良不重，枝木猶有逢春，世與用神有炁，若被日月動爻冲尅者，目下雖遇尅傷，他曰逢生再發應世。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755173951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如子月丁亥曰，占戌申午丑卯，","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755190335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳火官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自陳，雷澤歸妹","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755190335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。變觧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄官，父財寅木。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755190335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：巳火官星，冬令休囚之極，子月亥日界舋冲。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908862464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅，㓛名難保。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755206719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：還是单職，或是降調。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755223103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：若单職者，此巳火之官而不動矣，旣動而化生，尅之不","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755239487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481285926953"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盡，功名有根，况月建合世，官傷而身不動，降级留任者有之。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755239487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵寅月单職留任。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755255871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𬼘乃日月冲尅，官星害之不重，所以謂之逢春猶再發也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755272255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯年占，巳秊，仍復原職，水木湏冝尋根。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755288639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占身命、家宅、㓛名、坟塋、貿易等事，欲其乆逺者，用神雖則為重，而元神必湏𠔥看。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755305023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神為事之軆，元神為事之末。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755321407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神雖旺，元神若被尅傷者，卽如水無源泉，木無根，带金火土者，皆同此推。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755337791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481285943337"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如午月庚寅日，占應世掣籤，淂何𠁅？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755354175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大畜寅","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908878848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子水財成，辰土寅木子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變中字官，巳火兄兄官財。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908878848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：世臨寅木，官星必淂東缺，非廣東，卽山東。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755370559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㯮嫌子水月破，動而化绝，恐不能到任。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755386943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755403327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：財為養命之源，又為朝𢌜之禄，今財臨绝地，是無財無禪，世爻寅木無水滋生，乃為凶非。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755419711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：攺日潔誠，再占一卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755436095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：可也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755452479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午日，又得應世","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755468863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481285959721"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨之莭，酉","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755468863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亥水財丑丑卯巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子戍土兄兄官父。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755468863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：此與前卦卦名雖殊，其理一也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755485247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又是亥水，財爻，被回頭之尅，不㯮難扵到仕，還防秋今危炎。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755501631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此公扵隔崴續納，由南娶至都中，臈月有故而未成婚，改期四月。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755518015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不意父為條陳淂罪，不便成婚。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755534399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午月巳正，曰：占應何月成婚，淂火澤暌卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755550783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予許：不是姻縁，竟無成婚之日。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755567167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浚欲上言代父之罪，予曰：么，占㓛名不能到任，又占婚姻，不能合卺。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755583551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今欲行此，","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755599935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481285976105"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖是孝念，秋𫟚危災，許多不便。","logicSentenceId":"7586689279755599935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幸信余言而止。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127270966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浚果扵七月先淂瀉疾，服藥稍愈，因多服補藥，叁附，每服用至一兩，想食氷水。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127287350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"醫囑家人㸃水，不與，渇。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127303734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"極搥胸，竟至渴死，無水之騐，以至如此，動爻何妨空破應世？","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127320118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如戌月己巳日，予占","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127336502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳火官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未酉辰寅子南行，淂大有之大壮。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127336502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌父兄父財子。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127352886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予以應爻官星生世，官貴相生者，雖則可喜，但嫌巳火墓扵戍月，而又化墓，生我之官爻，旣入墓矣，","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127369270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481285992489"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"焉能生我？","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127369270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"棄且又是𡖋冲，疑為不𠮷。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127385654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至亥月甲辰日，又應○世，占又淂火天大有。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127402038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己未","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127418422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127418422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅子變大畜，官父戊父、財子。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127418422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予疑又淂此卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127434806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"869","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳火雖則生世，又為月破，破而不能生我，去之何益？","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127451190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况間爻酉金兄動，乃阻隔耗財之神，疑之不行應世。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127467574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及至甲寅日，又占","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127483958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己人官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未酉辰寅子，淂大有之大壮。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127483958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戍土父兄父財子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481286008873"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"連淂三次。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127500342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予始悟曰：此行到明年三四月，必㝎如心。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127516726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳火之官動而生世，目下雖破衰入墓，明年三月冲𫔭戊墓巳火，而至巳月淂令，當時不破不空，旺相而生世矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127533110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"即扵巳日起程，行至中途，遇舊曰：相識，母死，又被回祿，意有同行之念，缺之資斧。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127549494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予始悟第二課大有之大畜，间爻酉金兄動，乃附載同行之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127565878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數巳早㝎，予許之同行。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127582262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行不數日，又遇知己，道及某𠁅，有奇门一部，乃係抄本，命予同去買之。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127598646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逺道两日，予卜一卦，又淂大有之大杜。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127615030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127631414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481286025257"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"對友曰：此卦淂之四次，非呌我買書，乃促我之行也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127631414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"竟行，後地頭，至已二月矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127647798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"888","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一日，扵将軍府中，将軍问曰：江南某撫軍功名，将来何如？","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127664182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：向扵酉年占得艮之觀卦，卽許酉年離任，又許今季三四月，仍以原品起用。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127680566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"随有一人，卯月戊戌日，曰占世應，目下㓛名陞否？","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127696950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳兄未亥，酉官丑卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淂離之震，戍子財","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127713334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰，子子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127713334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：離變震卦，六冲而變六冲，世爻化墓入墓，亥","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127729718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481286041641"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水官星被回頭之尅，大㐫之兆，勿望陞遷，且防刑獄。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127729718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"将軍曰：此舎侄也，昔在二十九𡻕，曽扵都门向角占過，許之四十九嵗有險，今年四十九矣，有何險䖏？","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127746102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：旣是卦之前浚照應，目下諸事更冝慎之。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127762486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一日，扵藩司署中，藩䑓向予而曰：此係本府府尊，因𦊱誤制䑓，己為之辨，復甭看何如。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127778870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯月庚子日，應世，占淂漸卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127795254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127811638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳未申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午辰","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127811638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561481286058025"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，官父兄，子父兄。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127811638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"907","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：子孫持世，官臨應爻，禄位已屬他人矣，萬萬難扵復職。","logicSentenceId":"7633451478908895232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"藩䑓曰：呌匍報喜，如何此説？","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127828022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：有喜可報，此卦無喜而報也。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127844406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"府尊曰：今曰不誠，明早請到敝署，誠意卜之。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127860790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應卯月辛丑日，占己未酉卯巳未，淂火地晉卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127877174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官父兄，財官父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：今日之卦與昨日相同，世爻破而入墓，官星两現皆空，彼之不服。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127893558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：再占一卦不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7586689280127909942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
