{"lines":[{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：官鬼空伏，父母無炁而財爻旰動者，必旱。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086667802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086684186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孫空伏，妻財无炁而父爻旺動者，必潦。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086684186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再遇日月動爻生扶者，潦必至扵浸没。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086700570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：若重旺哀，此論何甞無理。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086716954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予存四十餘年之占騐，天時無日不占。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086733338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時當潦者，鬼動点雨，兄動与雨，父鬼休囚無氣者，動亦有雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086749722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時當旱者，父持月建，𡖋不過濃雲重霧灑塵而已。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086766106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故章後有云：競發父官，連朝風雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086782490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡遇卦中父鬼亂發，而雨水連","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086798874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549133807616"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"绵而不止也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086798874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福徳帶刑，日月必蝕。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086815258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃特占日月之論，不可以占隂晴之卦、偶而湊合者而妄㫁也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086831642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占雨，","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086864410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘父爻不動，而妻財晴動者，𮟃主晴明；占晴，","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086864410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若財子不動，而父母晴動者，還主有兩。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086864410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊係晴利父爻之入墓，謂父爻入墓，或動而化墓，","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236659775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549133824000"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必主晴明。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236659775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予以為非父爻入墓冲闬之時，則雨何淂利扵占晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086913562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"悼父動化退神，勢必情也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086929946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如北月戊辰日久雪占晴，淂随之震。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086946330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：鬼化退神，雨将止矣。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236676159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵酉時霧散天開。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086962714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡淂父化退神，雨命将止；兄動化退神，雲将開矣。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236692543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫財爻化退者，晴不久矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635086979098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余以此論是理。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087044634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此章首句原係妻財發動，八方咸仰晴光，予故攺曰子孫發動，萬里晴光，實此意耳。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087061018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父衰鬼旺，少雨濃雲。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087077402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦值暗冲，雖空有望。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087142938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金鬼動而逢空，差遇本日日建相冲，或浚遇冲空","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087536154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549133905920"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"實空之日，必然動雷。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087536154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之金空則响。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087552538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金化金者，迅雷霹震；火鬼動者，電掣金蛇。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087568922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如未月丙午日占","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087798298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何日雨，淂離之旅","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087798298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549133938688"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087798298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：卯木父動，臨扵旬空，己酉日若不雨者，卯日必雨。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236807231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：如何㝎在两日？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087831066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：不難。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087847450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"角再占一卦，又淂藏卦不動。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087863834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：此卦還與前卦相同，爾再占一卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087880218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又淂艮之謙：","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087896602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：甲寅日隂雲，乙卯日必雨，辰日而又晴矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087912986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：何以知之？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087929370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：此卦又是寅木鬼動，值旬空出","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087945754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549133955072"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空之日，必於天變。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087945754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前卦卯木父變辰土子孫，故知卯日必兩，辰日必晴。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236823615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵寅日宻雲，卯日大雨，辰日大晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087962138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𠩄以動則不為空矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087978522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雨遇财興，欲雨湏淂財墓绝。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635087994906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占雨湏冝父動鬼動，倘父鬼不動，又見財與子孫動者，湏待財爻入墓之日，及臨绝之日，𦆵淂有兩。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635088011290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占晴湏冝財動子動個。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635088027674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若父毋又動，湏待父爻臨墓絶之曰，方能淂晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635088044058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如戊月丙午日占","logicSentenceId":"7586684635088060442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549133971456"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何日雨，淂坎之井。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635088060442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：今日占雨，如何又動財爻？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635088093210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"想是大旱而無兩也。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236839999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：非也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635088109594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化出酉父，自日就當有兩，但因日建又是午火，必待戊日午火入墓，方纔有雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635088125978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵酉日天變，戊日而雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635088142362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午火財爻墓扵戌也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635088158746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如午月乙卯日占天何日晴，淂晋之歸妹。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236872767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549134004224"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：父鬼疂見，乃連朝風雨之象。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236889151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次日又占，又是鬼父同興，果雨四十餘日。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635132788763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未月甲午日占天何日雨，淂屯變益。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635132821531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大旱望雲霓。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236905535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中父爻不動，子孫重疂，化進神，疑其亦爻入墓之日必雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635132837915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又令他人占之，又淂財興子動，次日又占，並無父動鬼動，知其旱矣，果扵兩月不雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635132854299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549134020608"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦得反吟，晴雨終湏反復。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635132870683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tc74a/1-7630190290339446799_QQ_1776542304261.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=e%2B7YyQgf%2FKIGXI666WDWCvaFSGA%3D","pictureHeight":508,"pictureWidth":218,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tc74a/1-7630190290339446799_QQ_1776542304261.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=0YVGe8dw%2B4r7Q2rDzVwQLJ0vNfg%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tc74a/1-7630190290339446799_QQ_1776542304261.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰月庚寅日占何日晴，得觀之升。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635132887067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：卯水財現，明日必晴。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236921919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但卦淂内外反吟，晴而還雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635132903451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵次日睛晴而又雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635132919835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻逢伏象，旱沧離待冲開。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635132936219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏吟卦動如不動，子財動者，冲開之日必晴；父爻動者，冲開之日必雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635132952603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549134036992"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰月甲戌日占雨，淂大壮變震卦。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635132968987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占雨父爻不動，兄鬼同動，八動生風，無雨而有風也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635132985371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽扵本日申時冲開寅木，拔木任風。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133001755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合父鬼冲開，有雷則雨；","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133018139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"含財兄尅破，無風不晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133018139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母合住，本主不雨。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236938303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇鬼動冲開，必待雷震而浚有雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133034523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中若無鬼爻動，而他爻冲動者，亦必有雨；他爻又無冲動者，須待冲開之日有雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133050907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財子兩爻被合，亦同此推。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133067291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549134053376"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：合父鬼冲開，冲開之日必雨；合財合子，冲尅之日必晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133083675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有雷有風者，乃偶然耳，不必執之。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133100059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"半晴半雨，","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133116443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中財父同動。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133116443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註妻財父母同興，或是子孫鬼爻同動，必然半晴半雨。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236954687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余以此論即謬，殊不知各應其時。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133149211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如酉月癸未日占何日情，淂訟之随","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133165595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133165595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦子孫父母同興，寅木父化巳火兄，又是一日","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133181979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549134069760"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂雨，直至戊時天開而見星斗，應戌時晴者，戊土子孫而值時也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133181979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又雨又晴，爻上母子皆動。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133198363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如己月丙申日占何日雨，淂臨之蒙。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133214747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中父毋子孫同動，因巳火父空，交日冲空，則實亥日而雨，卽扵亥日酉時晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133231131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應酉時者，上爻動出酉金子孫之故耳。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133247515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前卦父與于孫同動，戊土子孫，應本日戊時晴；","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133263899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549134086144"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133263899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦父與子孫同動，應他日之雨晴之時也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133263899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：卽此两卦論隂晴各有其時，豈可謂之半雨半晴耶？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133296667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如酉月初五戊子日占中秋月，得小過","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133329435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之豊。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133329435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中辰父發動，當許中秋有雨。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750236971071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不知應在初九辰日卽雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133345819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰月癸巳日占甲午日監造，此日雨否？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133394971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼以父動有雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133411355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：甞見占日應時，且看今日申戊時而無雨者，明日實有雨也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133427739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵本曰申時禮。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133444123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549134118912"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼又問曰：如何申時雨？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133460507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：成土長生在申。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133476891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又問：雨乆逺否？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133493275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：父化退神，雨之不乆，明日必晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133509659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵次日大睛。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133526043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"野鶴曰：或問予曰：有動而逢合逢值，可能實知其一日也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133542427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：昔人不知多占之法，亦不明其此理。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133558811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"錯形有之，天機未肯全洩，全在人之通變。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133575195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人立敎，設此天時，敎人以騐人事。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133591579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽如子孫持世發墊，占天時者，皓日當空，無雲㸃缀，及至墓绝之日，黑暗無光，若占身命，𠛴烈轟轟，揚揚淂志，浚逢墓衰","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133607963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549134135296"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之秊，災非同至。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133607963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故予首言敎人以天時而騐人事，取効之速。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133624347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今𣣔實知一日者不難。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133640731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曽因官長有事，命在旦夕，因占淂子孫持世，勸之勿憂，必蒙赦宥。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133657115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼不肯信，意欲先尋自陳。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133673499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予設一法。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133689883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉月內子日占何日雨，蒙之臨：","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237020223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊一申前卦寅木父當應寅日，此卦午火父火長生扵寅，亦是寅日。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133722651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又呌人占，淂随之屯。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133739035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又見亥水父動，知寅日而必雨也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133755419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何也？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133771803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥水父動，動而逢合之日，二應寅日。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133788187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余以前三卦俱應寅日而雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133837339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦未土動變申金子孫，此應一爻獨發，知其未時必雨，申時大晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133853723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"清晨徃彼安慰而曰：卜公之卦，子孫持世無憂。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133870107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公不肯信，試看今日未時雨，申時晴者，公知我卦之靈，從此不湏憂也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133886491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼留扵家，見午末未初雨從西南而来，未時大兩，申時雲散天𫔭，合家喜曰：真神卦也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133902875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：旣知天時，何難知其人事？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133919259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公冝寛心。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133935643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"避半月，果蒙息赦。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635133952027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此因滿城欲装擡阁以賽神，因連曰忽雨忽情，不敢装纷。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237052991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余以此三卦合而决之，至癸未日必大晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134099483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前卦未土財化出午火子孫，古法謂之“合住財爻”，不晴，","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134115867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予甞淂騐，冲開之日必晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134115867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况此卦子日占之，子水巳冲開午火，而未土不能仆合，故知未日必晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134148635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第二爻丑土父母為雨，化出子水子孫為晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134165019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134181403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應未日冲開丑土，而子水子孫不能與丑仆合，点","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134181403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549134217216"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當晴扵未日。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134181403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第三卦午火子孫，子日冲之而晴動，動而逢合之日，七應晴於未日，果扵癸未日萬里晴光。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134197787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如寅月癸酉日，因連日雨，占何日晴，寅木子孫獨發，亥日不晴者，寅日必晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134214171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"許亥日者，動而逢合之日，許寅日者，寅木值日也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134230555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但六不能實指一日。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134246939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又命人占，得夬之需。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134263323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549134233600"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前卦寅水子孫動而至晴，常有應在，動而逢合之亥日，亦有應在寅日。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134279707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦亥水財動，故知逺日而無疑矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134296091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况亥值旬空，亦應實空之日。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134312475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵亥","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134328859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日大晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134328859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如申月己卯日早上天隂，占今日雨否，淂夬之大壮。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635134345243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因天隂而问兩，神不報雨而報酉時大晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447296051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予疑神之意雨已来矣，雨則不久，酉時卽晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447312435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵午未時小雨，申時雲開，酉時大晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447328819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦常多，後賢須冝會","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447345203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549134249984"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"意，要知雨巳来矣。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447345203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神不報雨而報晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447361587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：酉金爻動，動而逢冲，謂之散，又化退神，如何𡖋晴","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447377971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447377971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：旺金如何淂散？","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237069375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申金月建，如何淂退？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447410739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如卯月甲辰日天隂占兩，淂","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447427123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮之乾。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447427123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：從今日天隂起，有四日不晴。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237085759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：今日晴否？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447459891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：辰土兄化子水財，子水長生扵申，申酉時必晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447476275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明日巳曰㦯晴㦯兩，午未日必有大雨，申日大","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447492659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549134266368"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447492659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：何以知之？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447509043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：自初文辰土一動，連動四爻，父化鬼，兄化父，乃連朝之不晴也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447525427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第五文子水財化申金子孫，故知申日必晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447541811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵連日咸隂，或雨或晴，直至申，日萬里無雲。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447558195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如己月朔日庚辰占一月隂晴，淂坤之","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447574579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"師。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447574579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：巳火父動，父持月建，隂雨連旬。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447590963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此爻巳火父動，又是父化兄，風雨靡常，此月天澇。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447607347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：書中雖","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447623731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549134282752"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有此說，予試不騐。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447623731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明日已曰必雨，他日未必，果扵次日小雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447640115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以前篇予闢其隂雨速旬之謬，浚賢不可不察。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447656499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如己月丁亥日，因連日雨，占何日晴，得屯之噬嗑。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237118527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外卦父化父，鬼化鬼，還有連朝風雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447951411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上爻子水化出巳火財爻，要到巳日方晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447967795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：鬼旺而化退，父衰而化進，何以斷之？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635447984179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：父化父，鬼化鬼，乃神告我","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448000563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"連日之風雨也，何論𦔽衰？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448000563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知神意，旣欲報我","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237134911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561549134348288"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"連日之雨，又要報我已日之晴，非此爻象，歇盡此意。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237134911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今又以旺衰進退言之，乃不知通變之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448033331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"断曰：内卦辰土父動，又化寅木之財，辰日有兩而","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237151295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561627444592655"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不大。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237151295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉兄化出未土父，未父又化巳火鬼，必到未日而有大雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448197171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵辰日小雨，未日大雨。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448213555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tmqdm/1-7630381441076412467_QQ_1776587209093.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=2BEkz7ej%2FYGeCE7CmLs9amnbtJg%3D","pictureHeight":504,"pictureWidth":220,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tmqdm/1-7630381441076412467_QQ_1776587209093.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=XT3fifMwD5iuuw%2FWiA5cbVYBBPo%3D","uri":"read/XYXZSBY/25/ref/1m03bxr1tmqdm/1-7630381441076412467_QQ_1776587209093.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如寅月甲申日友約亥日逰春，予曰：連日雨雪，慮逰玩何能盡興？","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448229939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"友曰：今早占淂亥水子孫動，亥日在晴。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448246323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予卽卜之，淂豫之震。","logicSentenceId":"7586684635448262707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：子日方晴，夜日未必。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237167679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"友曰：我占亥水子孫，兄占子水子孫，必是亥、子日俱晴。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237184063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：非也。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237200447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄占亥水子孫者，旺扵子日也，亦應子日晴，非亥日也。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237216831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果於亥日還雪，子日大晴。","logicSentenceId":"7630461750237233215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如午月丙子日占世應財福，得𢑱之豊。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739829829647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉亥","logicSentenceId":"7679047739829846031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"母土，亥午火，丑卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世臨白虎，化出，旺財生世，果此人目不識丁，鄙俗不堪，農庄儘可度日，人丁六畜豊盛。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739829846031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊年占卦，值子年，庒被蝗䖝食盡，全家瘟疫，六畜亦瘟。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739829862415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應子年者，占時原有子日冲其午火，因午火而值月建，可以相敵，今遇子年，増其冲尅，所以破敗。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739829878799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母持身，辛勤勞碌，鬼爻持世，疾病绵纏。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739829895183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇兄則財莫能聚，遇子則身不犯刑。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739829911567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158286867"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄金策自此之後，皆非理也。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739829927951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母官鬼持世，竟可以勞碌疾病而斷邪？","logicSentenceId":"7679047739829944335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：有云：貴人占者，不可以此㫁之。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739829960719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼占身命，馬知不是貴人，便實知不是貴人，青知将来不貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739829977103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曽有人占財福，酉月壬辰日應世，占淂恒卦，","logicSentenceId":"7679047739829993487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戌申午酉亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑財官子官父財。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739829993487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"问曰：爾適間禱告，曽问功名否？","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830009871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：生意之人，何有㓛名之念？","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830026255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：此卦財生官旺，竟可问名。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830042639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830059023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158303251"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天有落下來之官，亦不到我頭上。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830059023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命再占名，世應淂噬嗑變否。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830075407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830091791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未酉財，辰寅子父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830091791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830091791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財兄未。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830091791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：世爻未土之財，變出申金之官，明明以財而變官。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830108175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前卦財旺生官者，因世臨月建之官，辰日冲動戌土之財，暗動生世，雖可許名，不敢指以年月。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830124559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後卦世臨未土，動而逢空，實空之年，包爾出仕。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830140943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵卯年援例入監。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830157327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳年初任兵馬，即加納縣令，未","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830173711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158319635"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年再任江南。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830173711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註：官鬼持世，疾病綿纒，若是貴人，勿以此㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830190095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人原非貴人，豈可謂之疾病绵纏耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830206479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如巳月己丑日，占终身財福，得歸妹之臨。","logicSentenceId":"7679047739830222863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌申午丑卯巳，官父兄未父財官。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704660515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：卦中財福不旺，而官文兩旺，如何不问求名？","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704676899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：功名之念已灰。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704693283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：世臨日建，月建生身，必主顯貴薦舉，巳午年，富貴逼人来也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704709667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵午年保","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704726051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158336019"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舉，雖非科甲，身為科甲之官，此豈可謂父母持身，辛勤勞碌耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704726051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母臨身，勞碌貧寒之輩。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704742435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：黄金策乃卜筮之宗，未有占身命而以父子財官兼㫁之理。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704758819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余曰：旣不為信，卽看父母持身之解註，便可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704775203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂占身不可見父兄官鬼持世，世爻遇父，則尅傷子女，一生勞碌，不淂安逸。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704791587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈非父為尅子之神，又為一生勞碌之神耶？","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704807971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"執此論之，但遇父爻持世，不獨勞碌，抑且無子，世之無子者，悉","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704824355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158352403"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆勞碌之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704824355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：占㓛名，父母持世，以之為詩書文館，如占財福，以之為勞碌辛勤。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704840739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官不旺而父旺者，雖不見用扵朝廷，名盛文傳，衰而又逢冲尅，卽欲寄食扵公门，凶多吉少。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704857123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如于月乙未日，占終身財福，得兊卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704873507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未酉亥丑卯巳，父兄子父財官，㫁曰：卯木之財，而入未曰之墓，巳火之官，休囚無氣，名不能成，利不能就。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704889891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惜乎旺父臨身，財彌髙而","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704906275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158368787"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"利彌寡，况淂卦遇六冲，一事無成之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704906275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後見屢逢顯貴，聘之才高氣傲，皆不得皆不得，瓜期而辭歸矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704922659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目撃十有餘載，貧寒淡泊，後随表弟陞任雲南，不知所終。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704939043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如午月壬寅日，占終身財福，得豊卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704955427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌、申、午、亥、丑、卯，鬼父、財兄、鬼子。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704971811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以占財者，喜之尅世，却不知占目下之财者，财尅世者必得。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070704988195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占终身之財福者，不冝財爻尅也，乃生平受財之累，因財之害也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705004579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且嫌父母持世，一世","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705020963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158385171"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無安逸之日，休囚又遇日冲，而為日破，如蜂釀蜜，誰苦誰甘？","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705020963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果此人原係農庒之貧人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705037347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勞碌勤耕，稍成家業。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705053731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後因逆子賭摶，首其子，並告窩赌之人。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705070115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其人自縊，致成人命，產業蕩費，氣鬱而亡，探之死扵午年，乃囙世爻申金，午月尅之，寅日中之，故逢火尅而死。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705086499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄又臨世，財耗貧寒。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705102883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊係遇兄則財莫能跟。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705119267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觧註有云：世逢兄爻，必尅妻妾，一生必不跟財。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705135651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣以之為尅妻，又以之為破","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705152035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158401555"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耗。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705152035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"執此而論，世之傷妻者，皆貧困之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705168419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假使貧者偕老，冨者㫁法，何以决之？","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705184803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故予以分占之法，實得理也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705201187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覺子曰：凡占財福，見父持世，雖不許之富足，亦看旺哀。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705217571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺則貧而好義，衰則多疾招非。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705233955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得日月生扶，貧而樂。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705250339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得日月作，財而合世，冨而驕。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705266723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺臨蛇虎元武，奸盗詐偽之兇頑。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705283107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰遇勾陳雀武，背負肩挑之窮漢。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705299491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"受尅受制，下賤隸卒。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705315875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得合得扶，上人擡舉，全在人之活變，觀其輕重而言。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705332259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158417939"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官衰無破，公門異術資生。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705348643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼持世，休囚無氣者，乃綿缠疾病殘病之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705365027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有貴者，或入公門，或挟術行道。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705381411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再遇日月動爻，貴人扶助，皆得貴客相親，從此成家立業。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705397795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財若無氣，空有虚名而己。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705414179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財弱有扶，商賈百工事業。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705430563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻福爻自来旺相者，或商㦯賈，或守農庄，乃生成之冨足，樂享豊饒。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705446947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘遇衰財扶世，或臨日月動爻，生扶合助者，暴發興家，守農庄，年時豊稔，習工","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705463331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158434323"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"藝，巧奪天工，慕道修行。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705463331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆為子孫持世。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705479715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫乃恬澹之神。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705496099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如若持世，孤立無助，又遇財爻失陥者，若有髙尚之志，許之為道為僧。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705512483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無出家之念，不可妄㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705528867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不知見子則身不犯刑，計之生平，不犯官刑可也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705545251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家傾名喪，乃因官鬼傷身。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705561635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡遇官鬼尅世，世爻旺者，生平多招刑憲，或招嫉妬，或小人暗害，或殘疾纒身。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705578019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若鬼旺身哀，乃身喪","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705594403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158450707"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家傾之兆，勸之不必以財福為问，速尋趨避之法可也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705594403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如世爻動而變鬼尅世，及日月作官鬼而尅世者，更凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705610787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰月甲寅日，占終身財福，得風澤中。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705627171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孚變水澤莭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：世爻臨未土，辰月助之，亦作有氣，但嫌日建傷身。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705643555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上爻卯水之鬼，化出子水之財，正謂之助鬼以傷身也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705659939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不必以財福為问，可问凶災。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705676323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：可逺避否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705692707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：今年九月、十月不可出門，可以避之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705709091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705725475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158467091"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"扵九月蒙官差遣，此人雇人代頂而去，中途遇害。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705725475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"似此之法，禍亦可避。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705741859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如卯月癸未日，占終身財福，得革之家人。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705758243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外卦，世與日月同為三合，以為吉卦，不冝世爻變鬼，又化回頭之尅。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705774627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上爻，未土又尅目下，雖則無妨，今年丑月冲開其合，或是酉月冲開卯木，湏妨不測。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705791011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果至巳月而生惡瘡，卒扵酉月。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705807395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財化退𠔃，不利扵己。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705823779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158483475"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻持世，化進神，或動而生世者，事業從此而進，家道自此豐亨。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705840163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若化退神，家業自此漸退，日剥月削，漸至消索。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705856547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若世爻再被刑冲尅害者，非漸退也，災非卽見，物覆財傾。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705872931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世逢合住，受制扵人。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705889315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世臨財爻，或被日月動爻合住，雖則豊衣足食，㝎然受制扵人，事不由己。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705905699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻若臨父兄者，而得日月動爻合住，衣食僅可度日，難扵豊足。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705922083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158499859"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻無氣而被合，財福無氣，兄動乹中，乃奔走受制之下賤也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705938467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"終身功名有無章弟三十八","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705954851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官父興隆，文章見用。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705971235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡淂旺父持世，官動生之，或官星持世，父爻旺動。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070705987619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或官星父爻旺動，生合世爻，或日月作官星，父母，生合世爻，皆主成名之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706004003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學成文武藝，貨與帝王家，鬼財摇發，纳栗成名。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706020387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158516243"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星持世，財動相生，或丗臨官，動化財，或世臨財，動化官，或官星、財星動而生合世爻，或日月作官星、財星，生合世爻，皆主納粟以奏名也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706036771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰月乙未日，占世應，终身功名有無，得地火明𢑱變豊。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706053155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此公原是武䕃，已任𤰞官，目病告退，卽無官矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706069539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"问：将来還有功名否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706085923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦丑土官星持世，化出午火，財旺生官，卯年占卦，巳年援例，連連加纳，官至府","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706102307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158532627"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"佐，未年出仕，戌年陞任黄堂。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706102307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古法以動而逢冲謂之散。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706118691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此係未冲世爻之丑土，竟不見其散也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706135075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如戌月壬子日，占終身功名有無。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706151459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得困之兌卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706167843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：寅木財爻持世，化出官星，終身之功名，以財而淂之也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706184227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：目下意欲援例。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706200611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：援例必妥，第恐不能出仕，六合優以冲，有始無终之象，果已考職，忽害眼疾，雙目失明，","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706216995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158549011"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨旺扵官，立功建業。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706216995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡卦中財典父爻，皆不淂地，而官星獨旺，或日月作官星而生世，或虎臨世動，或乕臨金鬼動而生合世爻，皆主立功以成名也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706233379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如戊月戊辰日，占應世，终身功名有無，淂寅子戊酉亥丑蛊卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706249763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄父財，官父財、日月作財生世，白乕臨金官持世，若入文途，必以援倒。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706266147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若入武途，可以立功。","logicSentenceId":"7679048070706282531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：有功名否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368722484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：官","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368738868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158565395"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星持世，日月生之，豈曰無官，後此人亦未食糧，竟随營破寨，奮勇當先，主帥嘉之，即以職官，不出五載，連建竒功，官至元戎。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368738868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368755252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰月己巳日：占戌。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368771636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申官，午卯巳未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"終身功名有位否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368788020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財自子，兄子財，此公考過州佐，因缺少人多，问将来淂缺否？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368804404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予見此卦五爻，申官化進神長生，有巳日辰月生之，但嫌不來生合世爻，疑是應扵獨發，請再卜之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368820788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：攺日虔誠再卜。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368837172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：更好。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368853556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158581779"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰月丁未日，世應占得晋之姤，","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368869940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未巳卯巳父，酉財官，未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官申兄、酉亥父。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368869940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余囙此卦參悟前卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368886324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前卦官化進神，動扵五位，不臨世合世，非分内之官也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368902708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦内得反吟，巳火之官被亥水冲去，明明現出，分内之官，已冲壞矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368919092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"将来之功名，非此考定之州佐也，另有奇𠁅。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368935476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：従何而得？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368951860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余曰：前卦官搖五位，官出特恩。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368968244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦未土日建動扵五位，似長生而生世爻，必得勅㫖而立","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368984628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158598163"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"軍功。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947368984628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此公亦知易理，问曰：兄父持世，如何有官？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369001012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余曰：此膠柱也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369017396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若非世值兄交，何淂五位之文書而生世，官星旺化進神，前卦已㝎就矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369033780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼又问曰：此時多事之際，正有此念，不知何方為吉？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369050164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：前卦申官化酉官，此卦世爻又臨酉金，西去大利。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369066548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果徃西行。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369082932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未㡬連立奇功，官至副使，加衔方伯。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369099316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午年升任山東。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369115700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歳五生世，平歩登雲。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369132084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡淂太歲及五爻生世，或日月入爻動而生世，皆","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369148468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158614547"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主庶民食祿，平步登雲。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369148468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"湏要太歲入爻，又冝發動。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369164852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘淂五爻生世，六要發動，而世與官星鳥冝旺相，方可㫁之。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369181236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古有存騐。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369197620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戌年戌月乙卯日，占闻駕至。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369214004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"吉凶何如？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人雖係庶民，乃一方之首領，忽闻駕至，迎之而淂将軍之爵。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369230388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗與五爻月建動而合世，世爻卯木之官又臨日建，神之徴騐如此，此非知我者神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369246772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158630931"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福徳動搖，豈是廟廊之容。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369263156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡得子孫持世，卦中子孫發動，終非貴客。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369279540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如戌月丁卯日，占终身功名有無，得需卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369295924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：子孫持世，休问㓛名。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369312308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：作何事可以成名？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369328692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：任甭才能𠋣馬，力能舉鼎，終身不許成名。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369345076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但此人㓛名之念切甚，讀書苦勝囊螢，文重當時，竟未遊泮。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369361460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後從戎二十餘載，或立軍㓛，或援例纳粟，","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369377844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158647315"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奔馳扵名利之塲，皓首無成。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369377844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此子孫尅官之徴","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369394228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"騐也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破空臨世，终湏白屋之人。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369394228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世静而臨，旬空月破，官逢月破旬空，皆主不淂成名。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369410612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟世與官星空破而動者，不以此㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369426996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如己月乙卯日應世，占終身功名，得旅己未酉、申午辰，肃兄子財、財兄子。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369443380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：雖是爻逢六合，嫌其子孫持世，官逢月破，勿想成名。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369459764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：業己援例。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369476148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：費盡萬金，终難食祿。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369492532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158663699"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後至子年淂病，丑年淂蠱疾而終。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369508916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又扵寅月丁卯日，曽占一人，巳考職矣，问後運、陞選何如，亦得此卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369525300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌年在地方多事，被人告發，革織","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369541684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"提问。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"終身功名之占，止知功名之有無。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369541684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中若現功名者，再问或文或武，㦯入公门，任其本念，指其事而占之，其騐如响。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369558068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君以一卦妄以文武㫁之，乃欺人之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369574452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曾遇武隂，占终身功名，卽此功名，终身還是另有功名。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369590836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱龍武虎蛇勾","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369607220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158680083"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯月戊子日，占世應，得大過，變井未酉","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369607220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亥。酉亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"廿","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369607220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官、申官父財，斷曰：另有㓛名。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369607220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中之酉金官星已臨破矣，卽是身上現在之官也，破而無用。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369623604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幸世爻化出申金之官，回頭生世，申乃今年之太歲，将来另有顯爵，出自特恩。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369639988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：従何而得？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369656372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：元武臨亥水，父爻發。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369672756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動，必目息盗安民之策而淂之也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369689140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：我何能有此長才？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369705524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又问：應在何時？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369721908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：寅年淂官，申年出仕，","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369738292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158696467"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後果因盜賊之事，除首有功。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369738292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅年叙功，先得武爵，後又改為文職。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369754676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申年陞任陕西副使，随陞粤東臬憲，亥年㘴陞藩䑓。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369771060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予扵子年到公署，又占。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369787444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯月辛丑日，占浚應世運㓛名，得歸妹。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369803828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變戍申。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369820212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午丑","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369836596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。卯財。巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震父兄官父寅鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369836596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：我特逺来，指望占得𠮷卦，預報開府，奈何事與心違，不惟不能開府，且有退休之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369852980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公曰：何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369869364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：月建之財，現扵卦象，尅世尅父，雖無币動，難","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369885748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7539561382158712851"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"免長上之災。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369885748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世点逢傷，自身六有險厄。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369902132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果扵寅年丁父艱，卯年回籍，至中途淂病而终，乃因丑土父母持世，叠叠卯木而相尅也。","logicSentenceId":"7679048947369918516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
